[previewyoutube=NZImkylMAYA;full][/previewyoutube][h3][/h3][h2][url="https://pso2.com/players/update/2025-08/#update05"][August Update Info][/url][/h2][h1]System updates[/h1]
[h2]Class Skill adjustments[/h2]
[h2]Fighter adjustments[/h2]
[b]Class Skill adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Fighter Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Defeat Advantage[/td][td]Increased Down Potency when used with Main Class.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload Short Cycle[/td][td]Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload After PP Preservation[/td][td]Increased the Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fighter Arts Pursuit[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Attack Impact[/td][td]Increased shockwave Potency.
Increased shockwave velocity.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Deadly Archer[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Expanded the attack range.
Changed specifications so that the distance retreated after attacking can be reduced by inputting forward.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spiral Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Changed specifications so that the distance retreated after attacking can be reduced by inputting forward.
Adjusted to allow movement after attacking when inputting left or right while locked on.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Twin Daggers adjustments[/b]
[list][*]Added an omni-directional guard point to the 4th step of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack.[/*][*]Changed specifications for the 4th step of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack so that when attacking mid-air with an enemy within a certain distance, the height of ascent will adjust to the target's height.[/*][*]Increased Potency of Twin Daggers Photon Blast.[/*][*]Increased the approach distance and speed of Twin Daggers Photon Blast when activated while a target is present.[/*][*]Relaxed the vertical approach angle for Twin Daggers Photon Blast.[/*][*]Changed specifications of Twin Daggers Photon Blast so that when attacking on the ground, the character will chase the target into the air.[/*][*]Adjusted Twin Daggers Photon Blast to allow movement while the attack is active.[/*][/list]The following adjustments will be made to Twin Daggers Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Circling Buzzard[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Expanded the attack range of the second half of the attack.
Adjusted the forward guard point of the second half of the attack to be omni-directional and extended.
Eased Hit Stops when attacked by enemies during the second half of the attack.
Adjusted to make the character face the target if no direction is inputted while the second half of the attack is active.
Relaxed the turning timing of the final attack in the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b] Double Saber adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Double Saber Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Julien Dance[/td][td]Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the turn timing of the final attack in the second half.
Added a forward guard point for the final attack in the second half. [/td][/tr][/table]
[b] Knuckles adjustments[/b]
[list][*]Adjusted Knuckles Weapon Action so that players are not moved too close to enemies when attacking on the ground.[/*][/list]The following adjustments will be made to Knuckles Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Swift Rush[/td][td]Adjusted to allow movement when inputting left or right while locked on or in Over-the-Shoulder View during activation of the first half of the attack.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thousand Blows[/td][td]Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed Sidestep cancel timing in the first half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Double Drive[/td][td]Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the jump cancel timing in the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Gunner balance adjustments[/h2]
[b]Class Skill adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Gunner Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger[/td][td]Changed the specifications to increase the Down Factor of Chain Finisher Boost according to the Chain Number.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger Increase[/td][td]Changed the specifications to increase the Down Factor of Chain Finisher Boost according to the Chain Number.
Increased the increase per Chain.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Boost[/td][td]Changed specifications so that if a special armament is equipped while Chain Boost is active, the Attack Speed Up level and remaining effect duration are restored to their previous values upon unequipping the armament.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chain Trigger Count Retain[/td][td]Increased the Chain Number of the next activated Chain Trigger when a Chain Trigger ends without a Chain Finisher Boost.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stylish Onslaught[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased charge amount of Hail of Bullets gauge.
Expanded the attack range.
Increased movement distance when the enemy is within a certain distance.
Changed specifications to activate invulnerability when nullifying an attack.
Changed specifications to activate the effects of the following Class Skills when nullifying an attack.
[list][*]EChain Boost Advanced[/*][*]EStylish Roll Counter Bullet[/*][*]EStylish Roll Strike Back[/*][*]EStrikeback Advanced[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]Strikeback Advanced[/td][td]Extended the Invulnerability Duration at start of PA charge.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Stylish Roll Counter Bullet[/td][td]Increased hit count and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Twin Machine Guns balance adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Machine Guns Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Aimless Rain[/td][td]Adjusted specifications so that there is no forward movement during an attack but to instead move in the direction of input.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Point Blank[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased movement distance when a target is present while locked on or in Over-the-Shoulder View.
Increased movement speed when inputting movement during the attack.
Adjusted to prevent moving too close to the enemy when inputting movement during an attack.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Waker adjustments[/h2]
[b]Class Skill adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Waker Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Familiar Support[/td][td]Expanded enemy search range.
Improved homing ability.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marmelo Strike[/td][td]Increased Stage 2 Potency when successfully nullifying an attack.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Marmelo Strike Tracing[/td][td]Improved homing ability.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hot Marmelo Parry[/td][td]Reduced cooldown time.[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]Harmonizer adjustments[/b]
[list][*]Increased the turning speed during activation of steps 1 to 3 of the Harmonizer Normal Attack.[/*][*]Increased the turning speed during activation of the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Made the Weapon Action cancel timing more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Made the Sidestep Action cancel timing more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Added an omni-direction guard point to the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down. [/*][*]Added launch and knockback resistance to the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Increased animation speed of the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][*]Made the input buffer window more lenient for the attack performed when Harmonizer's Normal Attack is held down.[/*][/list]The following adjustments will be made to Harmonizer Photon Arts
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Fredran Breath[/td][td]Increased maximum lock-ons for the follow-up attack.
Increased turning speed during activation of the follow-up attack.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Fredran Riding[/td][td]Eased the firing angle of the attack when the button is not held down.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wulfen Demolition[/td][td]Increased the turning speed during activation of the second half of the attack performed when the button is not held down.
Increased turning speed during activation of the stage 1 charged attack.
Increased turning speed during activation of the stage 2 charged attack.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Tech Arts Customization adjustments[/h2]
[b]Twin Machine Guns balance adjustments[/b]
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Machine Guns Tech Arts Customization.
[table][tr][th]Technique[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Aimless Rain[/td][td]Adjusted Type 1 to always maximize Potency Increase based on the distance.[/td][/tr][/table]
PAGE TOP
[hr][/hr][h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list][*]The hit detection for the arms of the following enemies has been adjusted.[list][*]Fortos Laser[/*][*]Fortos Launcher[/*][*]Val Zagga[/*][/list][/*][*]An HP gauge will now be displayed for boss enemies.[/*][*]Some parts of the boss enemy Malignant Dark Falz Vael will now be displayed on the radar map.[/*][*]For the boss enemies Crocodylis and Crocodylis Vera, Throw Actions that hit while the enemy is reacting will now be counted in the number of hits.[/*][/list][h2]Quests and Fields[/h2]
[list][*]Changed specifications for the Quest Info reward display and Quest Reward Details so that if the 1st Clear Reward has already been obtained, its display priority will be lowered.[/*][*]Changed specifications for the Incapacitation Menu of certain quests so that the Retire from Quest option will now be available when playing solo.[/*][*]From the end of maintenance on 8/6/2025 (Wed) (PDT) until the start of maintenance on 9/2/2025 (Tue) (PDT), all Urgent Quests occurring in the Stia Region will be changed to the Urgent Quest: And the Stars Fell D.2.
[u]*During this period, no other Urgent Quests will occur in the Stia Region. Please note that it will also not be possible to earn Titles related to other Urgent Quests in the Stia Region.[/u][/*][/list][h2]Interface[/h2]
[list][*]Changed the number of digits available for inputting Battle Power and Level Restrictions in the Recruitment Settings Menu under Recruit Party Members.[/*][*]For the DPS display, the numbers will now be left-aligned, and the maximum number of digits that can be displayed has been increased.[/*][*]The following changes have been made to the Victory Performance Settings and Select Emote section of the Lookbook. [list][*]The Emote currently selected under the cursor will now be played in the preview.[/*][*]If a button corresponding to a different Emote is pressed, it will be shown in the preview.[/*][/list][/*][*]In the Limited-Time tab of the Task List, the Campaign/Contents category has been split into Campaign and Contents, with Campaign being prioritized in the display.[/*][*]A Recommended tab has been added to the Task List.
The Recommended tab will display Tasks from the Campaign category of the Limited-Time tab.
[u]*If there are no ongoing Campaign Tasks, nothing will be displayed.[/u][/*][*]The window displayed for Select Emote under the Register Looks section of the Lookbook has been updated.[/*][*]An LG1 Rarity option has been added to the Auto Sell Drop Items settings.[/*][*]Leave Party has been added as a Customize Quick Menu option.[/*][*]The item name will now be displayed in the second tab of the weapon item details under the Multi-weapon section.[/*][/list][h2]Character Creation[/h2]
[list][*]Changed the specifications of the Salon so that the Log Window display and chat sending features are now available.[/*][*]The display method for some messages in the Salon has been changed.[/*][/list][h2]Items[/h2]
[list][*]Added the following items to the product list in the Exchange Shop: ARKS Record Badge Exchange.[list][*]* Trunkul Almati[/*][*]* Revita Almati[/*][*]* Revolcoat Almati[/*][*]* Alcinq Almati[/*][/list][/*][*]The 13-star Rarity Volgen weapon series has been added to the product list of the Exchange Shop under Equipment Upgrade II (Augment Transfer).[/*][*]Added new items to the Product List of the Exchange Shop under Purchase Build Parts.[/*][*]The Exchange Shop: SG Legacy Coordination Exchange has been renamed the Legacy Item Exchange.[/*][*]The item detail descriptions for the following items have been changed: [list][*]SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Hair)[/*][*]SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Pose)[/*][/list][*]Some items from the Super Origin Festival '25 SP Scratch lineup have been added to the Special Scratch.[/*][*]Added new items to the Card Scratch Ticket lineup.[/*][*]Changed the specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items are now available for exchange as Target Count Bonus Items: [list][*]MTN: Glide - Handy Propeller EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Handy Propeller EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Magic Incantation EX[/*][*]MTN: Idle - Magic Incantation EX[/*][*]MTN: Move - Giant EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Giant EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Lancer EX[/*][*]MTN: Idle - Lancer EX[/*][/list][/*][*]The icons for the following items have been changed.[list][*]C/Astrio S[/*][*]C/Endymio[/*][*]C/Hi Perio II[/*][*]C/Enhancement EXP +500,000[/*][/list]
[u]*The content and effects of these items remain unchanged.[/u][/*][/list][h2]Other specification changes[/h2]
[list][*]Added a new starter pack to the AC Shop containing a set of 15 Line Strike cards.
Cards included in starter packs can also be won from Card Scratch Tickets.
[u]*Please note that the cards included in the starter pack are not automatically registered to your deck, so you will need to register them by using the cards obtained after purchasing the set.[/u][/*][*]Added a support effect visual in Line Strike on the battle opponent’s side to clearly indicate when an opponent’s card has had its Attack power enhanced by the Vanguard Unit skill after being Overwritten.
During spectating and replays, this support effect visual will appear regardless of faction.[/*][*]Added an auto-focus feature for Line Strike spectating and replays to automatically switch the Card Details display according to the state of the match.[/*][*]Added a feature in Line Strike to display the Card List of your current deck during a match.
[u]*Assigned by default to the X key on the keyboard or to appear while pressing down the left stick on the controller.[/u][/*][*]Added card sleeves, play mats, and cards originally released on 6/4/2025 (Wed) (PDT) to NPC Victoria's Line Strike Card Recycle.[/*][*]In Line Strike, the English translation of the card title unlocked by CA: Wind 2 - Lumia and CA: Wind 2R - Lumia has been changed from "Heroic Sister" to "hero's sister" to better reflect the nuance of the original character.
Accordingly, the card "World's Fastest Hedgehog" will also reference the same card as Hero's Sister - Lumia instead of Heroic Sister - Lumia in English.[/*][*]Added a feature to let players toggle the "Look at the camera" option in Easy Photo Mode.[/*][*]Added more selectable Emotes to the Victory Performance Settings.[/*][*]A function to control the camera during skit playback has been added when accessing certain NPCs that appear after the Main Task: A Promise to Garoa.
[u]*For controllers: The camera can be operated using the R stick.[/u]
[u]*For keyboard & mouse: After clicking to advance the dialogue, you can drag before the next line appears to control the camera.[/u][/*][/list][h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[h2]Bugs to be fixed in NGS[/h2]

[u]*As a result, the Join Party function will no longer be available from party recruitment.[/u][/*][*]Fixed a bug that caused the map in the upper left corner of the screen to overlap with the Photo Room display after using the Photo Room in certain quests[/*][*]Fixed a bug in Creative and Alliance Spaces where some item icons were not displayed at times when purchasing Build Parts with SG[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the Braver Class Skill: After Combat PA Extension where under certain conditions the effect of increased gauge charge for Photon Bow Attack Impact was not applied when using a Multi-weapon[/*][*]Fixed a bug that caused the game to force close under certain conditions in Shops[/*][*]Fixed a bug with Wired Lances and Double Sabers where some graphics were not displaying correctly for the following weapons[list][*]Cinquem Series[/*][*]Weapon Camo: * Cinquem Almati[/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed a bug where certain Title Tasks that had already ended would sometimes be displayed again[/*][*]Fixed a bug on the PS4 and Xbox versions where the cursor would move to the top of the list when selecting Creation Data in Character Creation or the Salon[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the Task List may not display correctly when talking to the NPCs Leah May or Tim[/*][*]Fixed a bug where the reward names for certain Tasks were not displayed in the Task List.[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the Wanted Item List where under certain conditions the cursor position was not saved while logged in[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the Task List where under certain conditions the number of accepted Side Tasks was not displayed[/*][*]Fixed a bug in the Look Breakdown of other players that prevented registering Makeup Pattern Slot 2 as a favorite[/*][*]Fixed a bug in the log window that caused the game to force close under certain conditions[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the item Progrevance where the English description would not display correctly[/*][/list][h2]Bugs to be fixed in NGS and PSO2[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a bug in the Preview where some Weapon Camo graphics did not display correctly under certain conditions[/*][*]Fixed a bug where some graphics were not displayed correctly under certain conditions for the basewear Yukumo's Clothes T2 [Ba] and its color variations[/*][*]Fixed a bug where some graphics were not displayed correctly for the following setwear[list][*]Bathrobe Drip T1 [Se][/*][*]Bathrobe Drip T1/B [Se][/*][*]Bathrobe Drip T1/2 [Se][/*][*]Bathrobe Drip T1/B2 [Se][/*][/list][/*][*]Fixed a bug with the Primitive Pareo accessory where some graphics were not displayed correctly[/*][*]Fixed a bug with the Blue Katana where some graphics were not displayed correctly[/*][/list][h1]Things to be addressed during maintenance[/h1]

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the visual cue of the counter window for the Braver Class Skill Fearless Attitude.
Adjusted Potency for special armaments when the player’s Battle Power is 4400 or greater.
Fixa Attack: Increased Potency.
Fixa Termina: Increased Critical Hit Potency.
Fixa Fatale: Increased Critical Hit Rate.
Fixa Wix: Increased Potency to Weak Points.
Fixa Blastor: Increased Potency.
Fixa Guard: Increased Damage Resistance.
The EX Augments EX Enemy Down PP Gain and EX Enemy Down PP Gain II have been adjusted so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.
The screen-shake effect on some attacks has been reduced.
The graphics for some attacks have been adjusted to make their attack range easier to see.
The damage of some attacks has been reduced.
Adjusted the Boss Enemy Elimineda so that during certain Downs, only player attacks to its weak point will connect.
Reduced the damage of certain attacks of the Boss Enemies Elimineda and Destragras.
Player visual effects will no longer display in certain quests, including Trainia and Drills.

tags.balance_change: From the end of scheduled maintenance on 6/4/2025 (Wed) (PDT) until the start of scheduled maintenance on 6/17/2025 (Tue) (PDT), all Urgent Quests occurring in the Retem Region will be changed to the Urgent Quest: Shadow of the Fallen Star.

tags.feature: Added an Item Series search function to the Personal Shop search.

Relaxed the firing angle.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Zandion[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][/table][hr][/hr][h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list][*]Made adjustments so it’s easier for player attacks to hit the chest of the boss enemies Dustyl Hammer and Dustyl Vera.[/*][*]Made adjustments so it’s easier for player attacks to hit the weak points of the boss enemies Nex Aelio and Nex Vera.[/*][*]Adjusted certain graphics for the boss enemy Great Rappy.[/*][*]Some enemies will no longer reorient themselves toward the player after being staggered by an attack to the weak point at their back.[/*][/list][h2]Quests and Fields[/h2]
[list][*]Drop items have been added to the quest Leciel Exploration: Halpha Environmental Testing Zone Survey.[/*][*]Updated the animation prior to explosion of the Time Bomb Infernal used in Leciel Exploration: Halpha Environmental Testing Zone Survey, etc.[/*][*]Changed specifications for Nameless City Exploration: Nameless City Residential District Investigation to shorten the time during which no other trials occur before the Unlock Sign Collection Trial occurs.[/*][*]Changed the specifications of the Quest Menu at the Quest Counter as follows.[list][*]Newly added “Other” to the Quest Menu.[/*][*]Trigger Quests, Time Extension Quests, and The ARKS Chronicles have been moved to this new Other category.[/*][*]A new “Various Quests” quest type has been added under the Other category.[/*][/list][/*][*]Changed specifications so that Photon Chargesigne can be accessed while on board a special armament and while holding a throwable object.[/*][/list][h2]Interface[/h2]
[list][*]An explanation is now shown if the number of search results for Augment/Preset Skill Search under Item Search exceeds the limit.[/*][*]Up to 10 material items can now be selected for item enhancement.
[u]*Support items can be used as before.[/u][/*][*]The following specifications have been changed at the Item Trader.[list][*]Added a function to remove the New icon from items in the Top Menu when hovering on them, including from areas within those menu items.[/*][*]The New icon will now be shown when new items are added to the lineup.[/*][*]The New icon will now be shown above the heads of NPCs when they have new items in their lineup.[/*][/list][u]*When you log in for the first time, the New icon will be displayed for all products.[/u][/*][*]In the Free SG Scratch Ticket info window, the setting to prevent the window from opening has been removed and the specification has been changed so that the window is displayed in line with the others.[/*][*]Updated the Licenses displayed for the PC version and PS4 version of the game.[/*][*]Rarity of 12 or higher has been added to Rarity Settings for Item Drop Animations: Weapons/Armor in Options.[/*][/list][h2]Creative Space[/h2]

[list][*]In Line Strike NPC Battles, the decks used by characters at Beginner and Expert difficulties have been updated.[/*][*]The number of Card Scratch Vouchers you can earn from each Line Strike match has been updated as follows.[list][*]Unranked Battle: Victory: 12 vouchers/Loss: 4 vouchers/Draw: 6 vouchers[/*][*]Ranked Battle: Victory: 15 vouchers/Loss: 6 vouchers/Draw: 8 vouchers[/*][*]NPC Battle: Victory: 8 vouchers/Loss: 2 vouchers/Draw: 4 vouchers[/*][*]Free Battle: Victory: 4 vouchers/Loss: 4 vouchers/Draw: 4 vouchers[/*][/list][/*][*]In Line Strike, changed specifications so that it is no longer possible to select to Leave in the interval between the end of matchmaking and the start of the match.[/*][*]In Line Strike, changed specifications so that the chat window can be used while in a match.
However, you cannot use it to chat with Nearby Characters during Ranked Battles or Unranked Battles.[/*][*]In Line Strike, changed specifications so that the play screen is always reflected in screenshots taken during a match, regardless of the settings for UI Display When Taking Screenshots under Options → Graphics.[/*][*]Added Card Sleeves, Play Mats, and the cards released on 9/18/2024 (Wed) (PDT) to the NPC Victoria’s Recycle Line Strike Cards.[/*][*]Added two starter packs with 15 Line Strike cards each to the AC Shop.

We apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience as we work to correct this bug.[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[h2]Bugs to be fixed in NGS[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where players could participate in the Combat Sectors Dext Base Rank 2 and Neusen Plant Rank 2 even if their Battle Power was below the required level

[h1]System updates[/h1][h2]Class Skill adjustments[/h2][h3][u]Techter adjustments[/u][/h3][h3]Class Skill adjustments[/h3]The following adjustments will be made to Techter Class Skills.

[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Shifta/Deband[/td][td]Reduced cooldown time at the start of quests, etc.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Long Range Shifta/Deband[/td][td]Reduced cooldown time at the start of quests, etc.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overemphasis[/td][td]Reduced cooldown time.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wand Guard Reflection[/td][td]Relaxed firing angle.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wand Parry Counter[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased movement speed and distance.
Made adjustments so that the player does not move too close to enemies when attacking.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wand Parry Counter Advanced[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Changed specifications so that Photonic Fury is generated when the shockwave part hits the enemy, rather than during the counter part.

[u]*Also changed specifications so that when this skill is acquired, the counter portion of the skill will not generate Photonic Fury.[/u]
Expanded the range of the shockwave attack and adjustments made so that the attack will hit the enemy's weak points more easily.
Adjusted the PP Recovery Amount for the counter and shockwave portions.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wand Lovers Line Force[/td][td]Increased Potency for the 1st through 4th steps of a normal attack.

Relaxed the fall timing for the 1st to 4th steps of a normal attack.
Made adjustments for the 1st to 4th steps of a normal attack so that the player does not get too close to the enemy when attacking.
Changed the specifications of the 1st to 4th steps of a normal attack so that when attacking on the ground, if the target's altitude is significantly higher, the player will move closer to the target in the air.
Increased the Potency of Sidestep Strike.
Increased the Potency of Sidestep Counters.
Increased the Potency of Wand Parry Counter.
Changed the specifications for Wand Parry Counter so that when attacking on the ground, if the target's altitude is significantly higher, the player will move closer to the target in the air.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wand Technique Skip Beat[/td][td]Changed the specifications so that it can also be activated with an uncharged Technique.
Adjusted mobility performance.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Wand Element Pursuit[/td][td]Increased Potency.

notes.title: 9/2 End of unscheduled maintenance announcement
notes.content:
The unscheduled maintenance that started on 9/2/2024 (Mon) 7:00 PM (PDT) ended on 9/2/2024 (Mon) 10:00 PM (PDT).
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the unscheduled maintenance.
We are also discussing appropriate compensation for the unscheduled maintenance.
Further details regarding compensation will be announced at a later date.
[h2]Maintenance Details[/h2]
[h3]Things addressed during maintenance[/h3]
[list][*]Correction of a bug with the Get 100 million EXP! Rapid-fire Training Campaign for Beginners & Returning Players campaign where the Task that distributes N-EXP +100,000,000 does not activate after the 8/28/2024 (Wed) (PDT) maintenance
[u]*After the unscheduled maintenance, the Task will also be re-activated for players who had already completed the Task before the start of maintenance on 8/28/2024 (Wed) (PDT).
The extra N-EXP +100,000,000 obtained can be used as-is without any issues.[/u][/*][/list]Furthermore, we understand that there will be a discrepancy in the number of N-EXP +100,000,000 obtained by players who were logged in before the start of maintenance on 8/28/2024 (Wed) (PDT) and those who were not and will be distributing the following item to those who have fulfilled the Task conditions to ensure that everyone receives two N-EXP +100,000,000 each.

[hr][/hr][h3]About Alliance Spaces[/h3]
Alliance Spaces is a feature that was implemented in the 8/2/2023 (PDT) update. These Spaces can be shared by Alliance members.

If you have not yet joined an Alliance, now’s your chance to join one and try out Alliance Space.

[hr][/hr][h3]Precautions[/h3]
[i]Even if you fulfill the conditions with multiple characters, you can only receive one gift per account.

The content and schedule of the campaign may change due to unforeseen operational reasons. Thank you for your understanding.

Please note that items distributed in this campaign may also be distributed in other campaigns.[/i]

[url=https://pso2.com/players/news/i_teamup_20230802/ style=button]More information[/url]

[hr][/hr][h3]What are SG Legacy Coordination Badges?[/h3]
These are badges that let you pick your favorite item from a selection of items previously released in SG Scratch Tickets.

There are two types, SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Hair) and SG Legacy Coordination Badge (Pose), each of which can be exchanged for an item in the corresponding category.

[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [td][i]*The Hair badge can be exchanged for a hairstyle, and the Pose badge can be exchanged for an Emote or Motion Change.

notes.title: Check out what's coming in the August update!
notes.content:
[h2]August Update Info[/h2]
https://youtu.be/pYvBrntK6xs
[hr][/hr][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fc33e8354ee5de217f070b61e4f09ea6672bac2b.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr][h2]A new Weapon Series - Verschmelz![/h2]
This Weapon Series has Potentials that have a 100% Critical Hit Rate! Get the new item Growthment in Leciel Exploration and exchange it for Verschmelz weapons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0d81ca710f9d8e0e5088e4225c9d8fd6dee8b3b1.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr][h2]New features in the Creative Space and more![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6ac549caf694f9e46e6a7f36e1d5245e9d39ccb2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Try out the new Retem theme![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b9a98249ad648298afa1c413ca08d6a6550dc9b6.jpg[/img]

[h3]There's a variety of new Build Parts too![/h3]
[hr][/hr][h2]Enhance Preset Skills![/h2]
[h3]Enhancing Preset Skills feature coming to the Item Lab[/h3]
You can add a random Preset Skill to weapons and armor by spending Material Items and N-Meseta.
If a weapon or armor already has a Preset Skill attached, you can level up that Preset Skill!

[i]*Material Items must be armor or weapons that can be made into multi-weapon with Preset Skills of the same level as the base item or greater.

*Addition and enhancement have fixed rates of success. Material Items and N-Meseta will be consumed regardless of success or failure.[/i]
[hr][/hr][h2]Weapon Camos added to drop tables in some Trainia![/h2]
Grab popular Weapon Camos at the Geometric Labyrinth, Trainia Advance, and Battledia: Purple!
Weapon Camos including * Tarnada, * Rykros Staff, and more will drop!

[hr][/hr][h2]New features and improvements![/h2]
[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
[list][*]Change the Backdrop of your Status screen via Main Menu→Personal→Vital Gauge Design!
[*]Access the Quest Counter via Tasks/Quests in the Main Menu!
[*]Access Titles via Tasks/Quests in the Main Menu!
[/list][h3]DPS (damage per second) display added to Options![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c8b3a51056fd015ba65b1e0c6a4befc5ce8811a8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Teleport to Cocoons/Towers directly from the World Map![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/918e037c05bd5356be2b435f1529ef30b3c48990.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Advanced notice of the release of paid Level and Story Boost features
notes.content:
[h3]We are planning to provide paid features in the update on 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) that enable players to raise their class levels or advance their Story Progress instantly.
[/h3]

The purpose of these features is to support those who are just starting or returning to the game and want to catch up to and socialize with other players as well as access new content.
Moreover, we believe it will also help players who wish to level additional characters progress though the Main Story in a more efficient manner.

See below for preliminary introductions to each new feature.

[hr][/hr][h3]NGS Story Progress Tickets[/h3]
This item can be used to skip through the Main Story to the latest chapter at the time of use.
[list][*]The selected Main Class at the time of item use will get the EXP needed to reach the recommended class level to play the latest chapter.
[*]Purchase limit: none[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]Class Level 70 & Equipment Set[/h3]
This item raises the selected Main Class level to 70 and provides one weapon from each weapon category available to the selected class as well as 3 pieces of armor.
[list][*]Equipment items will be set to increase the character’s Battle Power to the amount they need to play the latest content as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT).
[*]Purchase limit: 1 for each class on each character.
[*]Items will be delivered to the OP Team Storage.[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]NGS Ver.1 All Trainia Explored[/h3]
This item sets the status of all Cocoons and Towers available as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) to “completed” so that players can acquire the Skill Points from the first clear reward.
[list][*]If there are Cocoons or Towers you’ve already completed, you will not receive the first clear reward Skill Points again.
[*]Purchase limit: 1 per account.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We will provide further details at a later date.

Thank you for enjoying PSO2 NEW GENESIS.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcdb5696c8ec2b8d1c0504521218ceddd516c02f.jpg[/img]
[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 4/18/2023 (Tue) at 7:00 PM (PDT) ended on 4/19/2023 (Wed) at 1:00 AM (PDT).[/h3]

[b]The version number on the bottom right of the screen is now Ver.7.2001.1.

Please see the following link and/or video for more details on this update.
[/b]

[h3]Update detail video[/h3]
https://youtu.be/QHRpxmpF48M

[hr][/hr][h2]Confirmed Issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug where some graphics of the Basewear Cyberknight T1 [Ba] and its color variants are not displayed correctly under certain conditions:

Cyberknight T1 [Ba]
Cyberknight T1/2 [Ba]
Cyberknight T1/B [Ba]
Cyberknight T1/B2 [Ba]
[/list]We are working to fix the above issues in a future update.
We apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience as we work to correct these bugs.

[hr][/hr][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Issues fixed in NGS
[/h3][expand type=details]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that prevented the Weekly Task Clear a Bunker Type 1 Quest from being released
[b][url=https://pso2.com/players/support/bugfixes/i_20230412_1/]Weekly Task: Clear a Bunker Type 1 Quest not releasing[/url][/b]
[/list][/expand]
[h3]Issues fixed in NGS and PSO2
[/h3][expand type=details]
[list][*]Fixed a bug that may cause the PC version to soft lock when logging in or logging out of PSO2 Blocks or moving between an NGS Block and a PSO2 Block under certain circumstances[/list][/expand]
[hr][/hr][h2]Maintenance details[/h2]
[h3]Things addressed during maintenance[/h3]
[list][*]In regards to the Item Name being blank for Mag Form/Blanc Cheval and its icon not displaying correctly, those who have not received the Reward Item Mag Form/Blanc Cheval despite having achieved the Title in question have been given the Mag Form/Blanc Cheval as compensation.

[url=The Item Name is blank for Mag Form/Blanc Cheval and its icon is not displayed correctly]The Item Name is blank for Mag Form/Blanc Cheval and its icon is not displayed correctly[/url]

[*]Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-6, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.

[i]*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.[/i]

[*]Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.

[i]*Ship transfers during scheduled maintenance are processed in the order that they are received. There is a limit to the number of transfers that can be performed during each maintenance, and if the maximum number of applications is reached, applications will be rolled over to the next scheduled maintenance.[/i]

[i]*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check [url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/gamestart/ship/]here[/url].[/i]

[*]When logging into PSO2 Blocks, each character’s location will be set to the Gate Area.

[i]*Characters may be moved to the Bridge depending on their progress in the story.[/i][/list]
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for playing PSO2 New Genesis!

notes.title: Events and Campaigns
notes.content:

[h3]Check the link [url=https://pso2.com/players/schedule/]here [/url]to see an overview of new and ongoing events and campaigns![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6eec2d9abb2ec1021eab70681897b725969f60dc.jpg[/img]

The long-awaited Slayer class is here!
Play Slayer and get a free Emote and Weapon Camo!

[h3]Get gifts: Slayer Support Items[/h3]
[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [td]                             From the end of scheduled maintenance on 4/12/2023 (Wed) (PDT)                                                           until the start of scheduled maintenance on 5/9/2023 (Tue) (PDT)[/td]  [/tr][/table]

In addition to a fully enhanced Renaissa Gunblade that can be equipped right away, you’ll also score an Augment Capsule and other items!
Get in there and try out the new Slayer class!

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/41186cec99769160ad96ba50fa1ca99620570bbc.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/5f0de99df237fdab3a485ab61a385380eb8b2396.jpg[/img][/td]  [/tr][/table]

[h3]How to receive items[/h3]
[list][*]The Renaissa Gunblade can be obtained by completing the Limited-time Task: Changing Classes.
[i]*Some of the information previously posted was incorrect. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this error. (Added on 4/12/2023 at 1:00 AM (PDT))[/i]
[*]You can obtain the other items via Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.
[i]*The items are distributed to the account, so please be mindful of which character you use to receive them.[/i][/list][url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/menus/mmenu/]Click here for details on receiving campaign items in NGS Blocks.[/url]

[url=https://pso2.com/players/news/i_slayer/ style=button]More information and additional Slayer campaigns[/url]

[hr][/hr][h2]AC Purchase Campaign[/h2]
[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]      [td]                            [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/3f9bb4781bec101c4b16b3838cae1e2fc53e60e2.jpg[/img][/td]  [/tr][/table]
Buy AC during this campaign to get extra gifts based on the amount you purchase!

[h3]Campaign period[/h3]
[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [td]                             From the end of scheduled maintenance on 4/5/2023 (Wed) (PDT)                                                           until the start of scheduled maintenance on 4/18/2023 (Tue) (PDT)[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[h3]Gift tiers[/h3]
[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [th]Requirements[/th]    [th]Gift(s)[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Buy 500 AC or more & log in during the campaign period[/td]    [td]N-EX EXP Earned +25% (x1)[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Buy 4000 AC or more & log in during the campaign period[/td]    [td]N-EX Rare Drop Rate +25% (x1)
New item: NGS Tote Bag (x1)[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Buy 8000 AC or more & log in during the campaign period[/td]    [td]N-EX EXP Earned +50% (x1)
New item: Puffy Sunny (x1)[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Buy 12000 AC or more & log in during the campaign period[/td]    [td]N-EX EXP Earned +50% (x1)
New item: NGS Tote Bag (x1)
New item: Puffy Sunny (x1)[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[table equalcells=1 noborder=1]  [tr]    [th]                                NGS Tote Bag[/th]    [th]                                 Puffy Sunny[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/5137ed22422251d2c61909d85ef787320bc3ae70.png[/img][/td]    [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/41d6ac3f27866895142c09b7a79d7bbeb94bf4e0.png[/img][/td]  [/tr][/table]

[i]*You will be able to collect these gifts from Receive Campaign Items after meeting the requirements.

*AC purchased through each store is added to your account by logging in to NGS. The total amount of AC added is then eligible for the campaign.

*Please note that AC is not directly eligible for the campaign at the moment of purchase.[/i]

[url=https://pso2.com/players/news/i_acbuy_20230405/ style=button]More information[/url]

[hr][/hr][h2]Great Bargains in the SG Shop![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0ed721ca51fde76028bff52657827575075a7145.jpg[/img]

Take the chance to pick up items to help level your Slayer at a premium price in the SG Shop during this period!

[h3]Duration[/h3]
[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [td]                             From the end of scheduled maintenance on 4/5/2023 (Wed) (PDT)                                                           until the start of scheduled maintenance on 4/18/2023 (Tue) (PDT)[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [th]Item name[/th]    [th]Contents[/th]    [th]Price[/th]    [th]Purchase limit[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Slayer Support Set (+ bonus)[/td]    [td]N-EXP Earned [24h] +50% (x3)
Bonus: C/Aegis Soul IV S (x1)
Bonus: C/Mastery IV S (x1)[/td]    [td]700SG[/td]    [td]1[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[i]*All Augment Capsules in these sets have an Augmentation Success Rate of 100%.

*They are available for purchase from the appropriate shop by selecting Shop > AC/SG Shop from the in-game Main Menu.

*Please note there is a purchase limit for these products. The limit applies to each account.[/i]

[url=https://pso2.com/players/news/i_itemsale/ style=button]More information[/url]

notes.title: 3/8 End of Scheduled Maintenance Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcdb5696c8ec2b8d1c0504521218ceddd516c02f.jpg[/img]
[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 3/7/2023 (Tue) at 6:00 PM (PST) ended on 3/8/2023 (Wed) at 12:00 AM (PST).[/h3]

[b]The version number on the bottom right of the screen is now Ver.7.1001.2.

Please see the following link for more details on this update.
[/b]
[url=https://pso2.com/players/news/update20230308/ style=button]3/8 Update Details[/url]

https://youtu.be/f9UqeVgeA0A
[h2]Spec changes[/h2]
[list][*]Some of the Gigantix and Dread Enemies that appear at the Dreisen Plant and in the Stia Outskirts have been changed:

[b]Dreisen Plant[/b]
The Gigantix Doldoris has been replaced by Engouku.
The Dread Enemy Blazentos has been replaced by Flamedyl Sword.

[b]Stia Outskirts[/b]
The Gigantix Engouku has been replaced by Doldoris.
The Dread Enemy Flamedyl Sword has been replaced by Blazentos.
[/list]
[h2]Confirmed Issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug with the Outerwear Mercant T1 [Ou] and its color variations where some graphics are not displayed correctly under certain conditions:

Mercant T1 [Ou]
Mercant T1/2 [Ou]
Mercant T1/B [Ou]
Mercant T1/B2 [Ou]

[*]A bug with the Baseware Mercant T1 [Ba] and its color variations where some graphics are not displayed correctly under certain conditions:

Mercant T1 [Ba]
Mercant T1/2 [Ba]
Mercant T1/B [Ba]
Mercant T1/B2 [Ba][/list]
We are working to fix the above issues in a future update.
We apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience as we work to correct these bugs.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[h3]Issues fixed in NGS[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where Item Enhancement could not be performed at the Item Lab under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug where the second half of the battle in the Urgent Quest: The Battle of Halphia lake would not trigger
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug with Offline Character Creation for the PS4 version where players would become soft-locked when selecting certain Edit Mode Motion Settings without having any save data from the Prologue or beyond

Along with this fix, the specifications have been modified to hide the following options during Offline Character Creation:

Greet
Confirm
Deny
Apologize
Provoke
Praise
What's up?
Point
Cheer on
Psyched
Big Laugh
Clap

*No changes have been made to the Salon.
[/list]
[h3]Issues fixed in NGS and PSO2[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug with the Baseware Shu Yamino Replica [Ba] and its color variations where some graphics were not displayed correctly under certain conditions
[/list]
[h2]Maintenance details[/h2]
[h3]Things addressed during maintenance[/h3]
[list][*]Communication Blocks, which are intended to promote communication between players, have been newly set up in each region, with 001 added. The Matchmaking for Communication Blocks will be carried out amongst the players in Communication Blocks.

[*]Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-6, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.

[i]*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.[/i]

[*]Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.

[i]*Ship transfers during scheduled maintenance are processed in the order that they are received. There is a limit to the number of transfers that can be performed during each maintenance, and if the maximum number of applications is reached, applications will be rolled over to the next scheduled maintenance.[/i]

[i]*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check [url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/gamestart/ship/]here[/url].[/i]

[*]When logging into PSO2 Blocks, each character’s location will be set to the Gate Area.

[i]*Characters may be moved to the Bridge depending on their progress in the story.[/i][/list]

Thank you for playing PSO2 New Genesis!

notes.content:

[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 2/14/2023 (Tue) at 6:00 PM (PST) ended on 2/15/2023 (Wed) at 12:00 AM (PST).[/h3]

[h3]Issues fixed in NGS[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where Region Mags sometimes did not display in their collaboration-spec visuals
[/list]
[h2]Maintenance details[/h2]
[h3]Things addressed during maintenance[/h3]
[list][*]We restored equipment where the Enhancement Level and/or other stats had been altered back to its status as of the scheduled maintenance on 1/24/2023 (Tue) (PST).

[i]*Equipment was not eligible for restoration if it had been discarded, enhanced, or put up for sale in the Personal Shop.[/i]

In addition, for PSO2 equipment affected by this bug that was obtained between the end of scheduled maintenance on 1/25/2023 (Wed) (PST) and the start of scheduled maintenance on 2/7/2023 (Tue) (PST), it was not possible to restore Enhancement Levels to their status as of 1/24/2023 (Tue) (PST).

As a result, we have restored only the Augments of affected weapons to their status prior to the bug occurring.

We are considering the appropriate compensation for players affected by this bug and will announce the details and timing of compensation at a later date.

[url=https://pso2.com/players/support/bugfixes/i_20230131_1/ style=button]The Enhancement Levels and other stats may change for Equipment obtained in PSO2 and kept in the Character Storage[/url]

[*]Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-6, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.

[i]*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.[/i]

[*]Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.

[i]*Ship transfers during scheduled maintenance are processed in the order that they are received. There is a limit to the number of transfers that can be performed during each maintenance, and if the maximum number of applications is reached, applications will be rolled over to the next scheduled maintenance.[/i]

[i]*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check [url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/gamestart/ship/]here[/url].[/i]

[*]When logging into PSO2 Blocks, each character’s location will be set to the Gate Area.

[i]*Characters may be moved to the Bridge depending on their progress in the story.[/i][/list]
[h3]Items sent to Receive Campaign Items[/h3]

[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [th]Summary[/th]    [th]Receipt Period[/th]    [th]Eligible Players[/th]    [th]Delivered Item(s)[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][url=https://pso2.com/players/support/bugfixes/i_20230131_1/]Apology for Character Storage bug[/url][/td]    [td]Until 3/18/2023 (Sat) 1:00 AM (PDT)[/td]    [td]All players (accounts)[/td]    [td]SG 50 Ticket (x1)
Special Scratch Ticket (x3)[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td][url=https://pso2.com/players/support/bugfixes/i_20230127_1/]Apology for a bug where some weather conditions did not occur[/url][/td]    [td]Until 3/18/2023 (Sat) 1:00 AM (PDT)[/td]    [td]All players (accounts)[/td]    [td]SG 20 Ticket (x1)
N-Rare Drop Rate +25% (x3)[/td]  [/tr][/table]
[i]*You can obtain Campaign Items via the Receive Campaign Items option on the Visiphone in PSO2 Blocks or Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.

*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be mindful of which character you use to receive them.

*You will not be able to receive items if you do not have enough space in your inventory or if additional items exceed your maximum carrying capacity.[/i]

Thank you for playing PSO2 New Genesis!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcdb5696c8ec2b8d1c0504521218ceddd516c02f.jpg[/img]
[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 1/24/2023 (Tue) 3:00 PM (PST) ended on 1/25/2023 (Wed) 12:00 AM (PST).
The version number on the bottom right of the screen is now Ver.7.1001.0.[/h3]

Please see the following link and/or video for more details on the 1/25 update.

[url=https://pso2.com/players/news/i_maintenance_20230125/ style=button]1/25 Update details[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YMAsphgwWDk
[h2]Spec changes[/h2]
The refresh times for certain daily/weekly content have been changed.

[table equalcells=1]  [tr]    [th]Affected content[/th]    [th]Before change (PST)[/th]    [th]After change (PST)[/th]    [th]Refresh interval[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Region Mag Wish List[/td]    [td]11:00 AM[/td]    [td]4:00 AM[/td]    [td]Daily[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Treasure Shop lineup[/td]    [td]6:00 PM[/td]    [td]7:00 PM[/td]    [td]Daily[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Weekly Tasks*[/td]    [td]6:00 PM[/td]    [td]7:00 PM[/td]    [td]Weekly[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]End of Limited-time Tasks*[/td]    [td]6:00 PM[/td]    [td]7:00 PM[/td]    [td]Weekly[/td]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Alliance Tasks from NPC Tim[/td]    [td]6:00 PM[/td]    [td]7:00 PM[/td]    [td]Weekly[/td]  [/tr][/table]
[i]*Please note that the availability of Weekly Tasks and Limited-time Tasks that end at 7:00 PM on the day of scheduled maintenance will end at the start of scheduled maintenance.[/i]

[h2]Confirmed Issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug with entering search words into the Wanted Item List where, if the upper/lower case letters do not match those in the official item name, the item is not displayed
[*]A bug with the Aegis Integra Exchange in the Item Trader where, when exchanging the Exchange Item: Aegis Integra and selecting items that exceed the Allowed Exchanges under Items to Exchange, the selected item(s) and the item(s) listed in the exchange confirmation screen do not match
[i]*The exchange will be successful if the selection condition of the Allowed Exchanges and the Items to Exchange match. If it does not, the exchange will fail and the Items to Exchange will not be consumed.
*Until this bug is fixed, if you wish to exchange Aegis Integra, please proceed after confirming the item selected under Items to Exchange is appearing properly in the exchange confirmation screen.[/i]
[*]In the Search for Currently Recruiting Parties, Neusen Plant was not displayed under the filter function category
[/list]We are working to correct the above issues in a future update.
We apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience as we work to correct these bugs.
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[h3]Issues fixed in NGS[/h3]
[list][*]Fixed a bug with the Hunter Class Skill Partisan Quick Assault where it could not be canceled by Weapon Actions at certain times
[*]Fixed a bug with the Gunner Class Skill Chain Finish Advance where the effect would end when certain actions such as stepping or jumping were performed while the effect was applied
[*]Fixed a bug with the Gunner Class Skill Chain Finish PP Preservation where the effect would end when certain actions were performed such as stepping or jumping while the effect was being applied
[*]Fixed a bug with the Waker Class Skill Familiar Support where the crest would continue to attack when switching to a weapon other than a Multi-weapon
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug where the effect of the Waker Class Skill Marmelo Patience was not applied at the start of charging the Harmonizer Weapon Action
[i]*In conjunction with this fix, the specifications will be changed so that the effect is also applied during the period between the activation of the Harmonizer Weapon Action and the start of the charge.[/i]
[*]Fixed a bug with the Potential Explosive Unit where consecutive area damage could be triggered under certain conditions
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug with Double Saber Whirlwind where, under certain conditions, the whirlwind stage would not increase and multiple whirlwinds would be deployed
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug where the boss enemy Dune Bear would not move
[*]Addressed a bug where the graphics were not displayed correctly while the boss enemy Big Frogga was downed
[*]Addressed an intermittent bug where boss enemies with down gauges did not go down, even when the down gauge was reduced to 0
[*]Fixed a bug where certain sound effects were not played for the boss enemies Dark Lemnas and Volt Lemnas
[*]Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Ikusa Bujin where some attacks hit multiple times under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Snowflake Kelkundo where the number of Kelkundo destroyed when the enemy was destroyed was not counted
[*]Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Snowflake Bujin where the number of Bujin destroyed when the enemy was destroyed was not counted
[*]Fixed a bug with the boss enemy Nils Vera where a Hit Stop would occur when hitting certain parts of its body
[*]Fixed a bug where the visuals of some attacks of the boss enemy Destragras did not match their hit detection
[*]Fixed a bug where Dread Enemies were not displayed correctly in West Kvaris and South Kvaris
[i]*The positions of Veteran Frostyl Sword and Veteran Pangolan will change as a result of this fix.[/i]
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, some enemies would move to areas inaccessible to players
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug in the Maqead Lower Level Combat Sector where enemies would not appear during a PSE Climax and it would become impossible to progress
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug in the Lost Central Combat Sector where Enormous Icicles did not deal damage to enemies
[*]Fixed a bug with the Gathering Item Famous Stia Crab where the animation did not play correctly
Fixed an intermittent bug where the sound effects for Frozen Item Containers, Cold Photons, Complex Minerals, and Lava Cores did not play correctly
[*]Fixed a bug where the color of a Color Variant Weapon was applied to the effect for picking up Lava Bombs
[*]Fixed a bug where some Score Symbols overlapped in the Field Races South Retem Dash (Stage 1) and Dreisen Plant Board (Stage 1)
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug where Lava Cores did not explode properly when hit with Lava Bombs
[*]Fixed a bug with the Transport Truck Defense Trials where the Transport Truck HP bar was not displayed correctly
[*]Fixed a bug with Relentless Training Across Halpha 2-X where the Task would progress even if the enemy defeated was at a level other than the target level
[*]Fixed a bug in the Salon where characters would appear dark during Live Concerts
[*]Fixed a bug where completed Limited-time Title Tasks in NGS Blocks were no longer displayed after the acquisition period had passed
[*]Fixed a bug where, under certain conditions, Trigger Portals were not displayed in accordance with their activation status
[*]Fixed a bug with Battledia: Yellow: Stia Troopers where gaps would appear in parts of the terrain
[*]Fixed a bug with Battledia: Kvaris Troopers where the Zams Gun attack used the same bullets as the Pettas Gun
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug with the Trial: Zonnel Destruction where the Zonnel would appear at a distance from the Trial Marker
[*]Fixed a bug with Cannonball Rumble and Cannonball Strike where the display at the start of the wave was that of the Geometric Labyrinth
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug where the hand pose was stuck in the standard pose when performing Emotes
[*]Fixed a bug where players could not properly adjust the number of items to exchange by pressing the + and - buttons when selecting items for exchange at exchange shops such as Item Recycle in the NGS Blocks
[i]*If the number of items can be selected but cannot be exchanged, executing the exchange will result in an error, and the selected items to exchange will not be consumed.[/i]
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug where the capacity after exchange listed under Item Info displayed when selecting items to exchange in exchange shops such as Item Recycle in NGS Blocks was not displayed correctly
[*]Fixed a bug where the texture resolution option setting was not reflected in some effects
[*]Fixed a bug with the options Voice Volume: Player Character and Voice Volume: Other Characters where the sample voices were not played correctly when the volume was adjusted using a mouse
[*]Fixed a bug with charging AC where the store was not displayed correctly in certain environments
[*]Fixed a bug with the Scratch Ticket window where the Scratch Ticket information was not displayed correctly in certain environments
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug where the second and subsequent reward items were not displayed under the Reward Item Details of the Title Task Details
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug in Whisper Chat where the display of the chat speaker’s name did not function correctly
[*]Fixed a bug with the Treasure Shop in NGS Blocks where SALE was not displayed even though the prices of certain items in the lineup were discounted
[i]*We have confirmed that this was a display-only bug and that the actual discount has been applied correctly to the price.[/i]
[*]Fixed a bug where some sound effects were played back too loudly
[*]Fixed a bug with the sound effect of the volcano erupting in the Stia Region where the selected settings in Options were not applied
[*]Fixed a bug in the Dreisen Plant where sound effects were not played correctly under certain conditions
[*]Fixed a bug where the model orientation for Adjust Vertical Pos. was not displayed correctly for the following Motion Changes:
MTN: Dash - Wheel
MTN: Dash - Wheel EX
[*]Fixed a bug where the cost of the following Motion Changes was set to 3:
MTN: Glide - Mini Glider 2
MTN: Glide - Mini Glider/B
[i]*The correct cost is 2.[/i]
[*]Fixed a bug in the tutorials for the Storm Zone Enemy Suppression Trials and the Zonnel Destruction Trials where the Titles differed from those in the game guide
[*]Fixed a bug where the names of hairstyles and Head Parts were not displayed under the Looks Breakdown in NGS Blocks
[*]Fixed an intermittent bug with Mag Jukebox where all items were displayed when searching with the text setting set to Japanese
[*]Fixed a bug with NGS Block Weapon Camo * Relik Helpores CV where the corresponding category listed in the description was incorrect
[*]Corrected a typographical error in the description of the Augment Stira Domina
[*]Fixed a bug where English voices were played even if the language setting for voices was set to Japanese
[*]Fixed a bug where the English names of the following items in NGS Blocks were incorrect:
Five-star Rarity * Koukloziat Almati series weapons
Weapon Camo: * Koukloziat Almati
[*]Fixed a bug where the English name of the Augment Capsule C/Vardi Soul IV S in NGS Blocks was incorrect
[*]Fixed a bug in the PS4 version where Emote: Art Pose and Emote: Ballet Pose were not displayed properly when combined with accessories with effects

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcdb5696c8ec2b8d1c0504521218ceddd516c02f.jpg[/img]
[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 11/15/2022 (Tue) 6:00 PM (PST) ended on 11/16/2022 (Wed) 12:00 AM (PST).
The version number on the bottom right of the title screen is now Ver.7.0801.4.

Please see the following link for details on this update.[/h3]

[b][url=https://pso2.com/players/news/update20221116/]https://pso2.com/players/news/update20221116/[/url][/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J_6Sh2Delp4
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Issues Fixed in NGS[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the Outfit Vohu Manah would change into an unreleased Outfit under certain conditions.

[i]*For those characters who experienced this problem before the scheduled maintenance on 11/15/2022 (Tue) (PST), the items in question were removed and a Vahu Manah Outfit was sent to them.

*If this Outfit had been registered under Looks, it will generate an error when applied. To avoid this, please overwrite the Looks data.[/i]

[*]Fixed a bug where the Potency Increase would always be applied to the Hunter Class Skill, Partisan Parry Alternate Assault, under certain conditions.
[*]Fixed a bug where some enemies would not spawn in the West Retem Exploration Sector.
[*]Fixed a bug with Field Race: Board where the player would occasionally be ejected from the Field Race at the start.
[*]Fixed a bug on the PC version where screenshots could not be saved correctly if the HDR settings were enabled and the save format was set to PNG.[/list]
[h3]Issues Fixed in NGS and PSO2[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed a bug with the CAST Parts N-Alice Reaper Legs where effects were not displayed correctly for some Motion Changes.
[*]Fixed a bug with the CAST Parts N-Amuaira Legs where effects were not displayed correctly for some Motion Changes.[/list]
[h2]Confirmed Issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug in the description of the Setwear Albedo Costume [Se] in which the text stating that Innerwear visibility is changeable via the decoration display settings is not displayed correctly.
[*]A bug in which the descriptions for the following accessories do not display correctly:

Japanese-Style Earrings
Alpha Reactor Earring

We are working to fix the above issues in a future update and appreciate your patience and understanding in the meantime.[/list]
[h2]Maintenance details[/h2]
[h3]Things addressed during maintenance[/h3]
[list][*]Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-6, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.

[i]*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.[/i]

[*]Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.

[i]*Ship transfers during scheduled maintenance are processed in the order that they are received. There is a limit to the number of transfers that can be performed during each maintenance, and if the maximum number of applications is reached, applications will be rolled over to the next scheduled maintenance.[/i]

[i]*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check [url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/gamestart/ship/]here[/url].[/i]

[*]When logging into PSO2 Blocks, each character’s location will be set to the Gate Area.

[i]*Characters may be moved to the Bridge depending on their progress in the story.[/i][/list]

Thank you for playing PSO2 New Genesis!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2c791d60c2eb6078bb2030b6275a7f2fee118e46.png[/img]
[h3]The scheduled maintenance that started on 11/8/2022 (Tue) 6:00 PM (PST) ended on 11/9/2022 (Wed) 12:00 AM (PST). The version number on the bottom right of the title screen is now Ver.7.0801.3.

Please see the following link for details on this update.[/h3]

[b][url=https://pso2.com/players/news/update20221109/]https://pso2.com/players/news/update20221109/[/url][/b]

[previewyoutube=RwStYx21Wks;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Issues Fixed in NGS[/h3][list]
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies do not work as intended under certain circumstances in Rank 7 of Ordinal Tower
[*]Fixed a bug where, after accepting certain Limited-time Tasks, players may be presented with a window requiring the completion of a different task[/list]
[h2]Confirmed Issues[/h2]
[list][*]A bug with ARKS Records where there are errors in the listed participation requirements under the Details section for Ordinal Tower (Rank 7): Solo and Ordinal Tower (Rank 7): Party.
[*]The correct requirements are as follows:

Ordinal Tower (Rank 7): Solo
Clear the designated Trainia Advance Bunker Type 2 Quest by yourself.

Ordinal Tower (Rank 7): Party
Clear the designated Trainia Advance Bunker Type 2 Quest with 2 or more people.[/list]
[h2]Maintenance details[/h2]
[h3]Things addressed during maintenance[/h3]
[list][*]Alliance Badges consumed in error due to the [url=https://pso2.com/players/support/bugfixes/i_20221021_1/]bug [/url]where the numbers of Alliance Badges required for the Gold Primm Sword and Gold Primm Armor in the Alliance Badge Exchange Shop were incorrect were returned to OP Team Storage.

[*]Along with the scheduled maintenance, the expiration of Premium Sets, Extended Storage 1-6, Material Storage, Personal Shop usage, PSO2 Personal Quarters usage, Max Orders Received Limit Expansion, and Bonus Keys will be extended by 6 hours.

[i]*The expiration for the above items expiring before the end of this scheduled maintenance has been extended by 6 hours from the original expiration.[/i]

[*]Characters that completed the application for Ship Transfer before the beginning of the scheduled maintenance have been transferred.

[i]*Ship transfers during scheduled maintenance are processed in the order that they are received. There is a limit to the number of transfers that can be performed during each maintenance, and if the maximum number of applications is reached, applications will be rolled over to the next scheduled maintenance.[/i]

[i]*For more details on Ship Transfers, such as the requirements, please check [url=https://pso2.com/players/manual/gamestart/ship/]here[/url].[/i]

[*]When logging into PSO2 Blocks, each character’s location will be set to the Gate Area.

[i]*Characters may be moved to the Bridge depending on their progress in the story.[/i][/list]
[h3]Items sent to Receive Campaign Items[/h3]

[table]  [tr]    [th]Summary[/th]    [th]Receipt Period[/th]    [th]Eligible Players[/th]    [th]Delivered Item(s)[/th]  [/tr]  [tr]    [td]Apology for the extension of scheduled maintenance on 11/1 (Tue) (PDT)[/td]    [td]Until 12/10/2022 (Sat) 12:00 AM (PST)[/td]    [td]All players (accounts)[/td]    [td]SG 20 Ticket (x1)[/td]  [/tr][/table]

[i]*You can obtain Delivered Items via the Receive Campaign Items option on the Visiphone in PSO2 Blocks or Receive Campaign Items in the System Menu in NGS Blocks.

*Rewards are distributed to the account, so please be mindful of which character you use to receive them.

*You will not be able to receive items if you do not have enough space in your inventory or additional items exceed your maximum carrying capacity.[/i]

notes.title: BRAVER CLASS: INFORMATION AND CLASS SKILLS
notes.content:
Braver is now here in PSO2 New Genesis!
Braver can use two weapon types (Bow and Katana), perfect for both close and long-ranged combat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/17c7c6347da32f43a03c102e6cdee15f1295bd7c.jpg[/img]

To get started with Braver you can do so at the Class Counter! 
Be sure to expand the class selection box under Techer so that it's viewable for selection.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fcd35acc5f739dc23a8aeb802a2b5637a1cafc08.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1ce9184bb9f0c0900e992f19837bcb525afdc998.jpg[/img]

[h2]Braver Class Skills[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8aadd9fea2629e2f057167cc3a9174e9b632cf2a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d657b84bc59164a5a88f9d9486a37657ae4a8bdf.jpg[/img]

[b]•Brave Combat (Active Skill/For Braver Weapons Only)[/b]
Reduces PP consumption and increases attack PP recovery for a fixed time. Using the skill again while already activated will launch a powerful attack. 

[b]•Resta Effect Amplifier[/b]
Increases HP recovery amount when you use Restasigne.

[b]•Katana Guard Counter Advanced (Katana Only)[/b]
Adds a shockwave to the Counter when performing a Perfect Guard with Weapon Action.

[b]•Bow Elusion Plus (Bow Only)[/b]
Using a Weapon Action while pressing the directional pad at just the right time after releasing a Photon Art will make you slide while attacking.

[h2]Braver Photon Arts[/h2]

[b]•Silverleaf Storm[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/21a4b6c9cac7fee699724aaf9aed59718086f840.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2eb2a06fa6658efcc37bbefff12df201647d9ff8.jpg[/img]

Katana Photon Art. Releases a forward slash after a swift sword draw. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

[b]•Iris Gale[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8e004585c173a0dbf3cdd4124913dcb27b66a86d.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fba8a6dd1297ec60590527f1e0e070c661fa618c.jpg[/img]

Katana Photon Art. Mows down nearby enemies after a swift sword draw. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

[b]•Lotus Lightning[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/391ebfde3c270da6bda24ddcb2f7ad0c57f010cb.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/490d976c8b1659844f76704f73e4e72b3b2832e1.jpg[/img]

Katana Photon Art. Releases manifold shockwaves in a straight line after charging your sword. Multiple uses release alternate attacks.

•Flex Arrow
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ce33696b282c130a73eb12c979dea4fa31c3d031.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fd7025f4a54016c09509942fb7d6eb73d024bd64.jpg[/img]

Bow Photon Art. Fires homing arrows. Can be charged up to two power levels to release different attacks.

[b]•Frenzied Firework[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/1bfe125832209b7dd5e70475a10f2adf6346e4cd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/99bcdf6b4dd4752d7580abd9fd373ef400bb0db0.jpg[/img]

Bow Photon Art. Scatters arrows all around when you hit an enemy. Charge to launch an alternate attack.

[b]•Dimensional Ray[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/00a1bd3c9c8c41f820c40e30dcbad604f5c9d440.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/95a376f7fa3e2d0db677e7184e6ebcfd4242b6dd.jpg[/img]

Bow Photon Attack. A bow from an alternate dimension rains arrows on enemies. Charging will cause the bow to teleport and release homing attacks when you land hits with other Photon Arts. 

[h2]Braver Instructor Deirdre![/h2]
[b]•New Side Task! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/ada2df196a35ce4f63fd8631dce9873cf92d4e1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0f6371e14c68e578abe36b18ce7f30ff3395947e.jpg[/img]

Deirdre is the newly-assigned Braver Instructor for ARKS. She’s an 18-year old Deuman, the same age as Ran. “Braver Basic Training” is a task in which ARKS Instructor Deirdre teaches the basic fighting method for the Braver class in a practical manner. Try out this task if you want to give the Braver class a try! 

[b]New Weapon Categories![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2eace5465a916a6082e5b0fabfb2ad538a49d58a.jpg[/img]

New Katana and Bow weapon categories have been added! The Katana has been added to the 4-star rarity Foursis weapon series, and the Bow has been added to the Vialto series! Weapons of 3-star rarity or less have also been added to other weapons series, such as Trois De and Theseus series, so be sure to get them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/92af9bdd7ada6137b075678ebae197c82a28d434.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a95a99b7b41a1d7d2012047f4b0fed61b2c21795.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6d13751bbe55d678a39915090e569b678b38b7c5.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[b]In the AC Scratch Ticket “Wedding Celebration”, we’re bringing you wedding dresses and tuxedos associated with June Brides, detective themed outfits, the “Deep Bow” Emote, and more! As a Countdown Bonus Prize, there will be an item for changing the Glide Motion![/b]

notes.title: AC SCRATCH TICKET: FRAME ARMS RELOADED
notes.content:
[b]If you’re a fan of FRAME ARMS and FRAME ARMS GIRL, be sure to check out this newest AC Scratch Ticket collection released on December 23rd! Read on for a sneak peek![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2f646022ded20dbcf82207e83f7785209cc1b8b3.jpg[/img]

If you’ve ever wanted to dress up as your favorite FRAME ARMS or FRAME ARMS GIRL, now you can with the AC Scratch Ticket collection [u]FRAME ARMS RELOADED[/u], coming on December 23rd! Get fully equipped with accessories and items inspired by FRAME ARMS, such as the [b]120mm Low-recoil Gun[/b] or the [b]Evolution Device: BASELARD G![/b]

[previewyoutube=7ikvS5D7qaI;full][/previewyoutube]

There are several types of Scratch Tickets depending on the currency used, from ARKS Cash (AC), Star Gems (SG), and FUN Points. Click [url=https://pso2.com/manual/fundamentals/ac]here[/url] for a quick explanation about Scratch Tickets! 

[h2][b]AC SCRATCH TICKET[/b][/h2]
Drawing an AC Scratch Ticket offers a chance to obtain an outfit, accessory, or consumable. Check the list below to learn what can be obtained by drawing a ticket from the FRAME ARMS RELOADED!

[b]Release Date:[/b] 12/23 (PST) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 01/20 03:00 PM (Asia/Tokyo)
[b]Price (per ticket):[/b] 200 AC
