notes.title: WHAT’S NEW IN EPISODE 6
notes.content:
[b]There’s a LOT of content coming when Episode 6 boards the Ship, operatives! Check out this article and study up so you’re prepared!
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/74295eeaa1a81419ca44d6f3b034e943376e11fb.jpg[/img]

So, you left the Sacred Magical Kingdom of Epykuento in the transcendent hands of a friend, and headed back to Fleet Oracle for some much needed R&R. The only problem is that your legendary feats in vanquishing one enemy inadvertently permitted the entry of another – and she even had the gall to thank you for it. As your experience on Alternate Dimension: Omega taught you, the universe tends to favor recycling things; though chaos often interferes and these re-creations can be – flawed. Add this to the newfound knowledge that your experience on Omega may not have been historically accurate, and you have the recipe for a grim sense of foreboding. ARKS will again need your help; to make sense of the past – and preserve the future.


There will be new training regimens, and new equipment that will better enable Fleet Oracle to meet this new challenge head-on when it arrives. Apprise yourselves of the contents of this notice, operatives, and then dispose of it in a secure manner.


[h2][u][b]WHAT’S NEW[/b][/u][/h2]

Some of the new changes and features include:

[list]
[*] New Story
[*] Player Level cap increased to 95
[*] New Classes – Phantom & Étoile
[*] New Summoner Pets – Herbie and Vulcan
[*] New Urgent Quests
[*] New Quest Type – Risk Exploration
[*] Arms Extension
[*] New Quest Difficulty – Ultra-Hard (UH)
[*] New ARKS Missions
[*] New Rising Weapons Badge
[*] New Enemy Type – Luminmech and Ultra Enemies
[*] New Seasonal Events
[*] New Mission Pass Season
[*] Exciting new Titles to earn
[*] Additional Recommended Quest – Level Up Quest
[*] New Collection Folders – Legendary 15★ Collection Folder, 14★ Eggs Collection 1
[*] New Bonus Quest – Special Mission: Tokyo [Rainbow]
[*] New Practice Quests – Étoile, Phantom, AIS Vega
[*] New S-Grade Augments
[*] New 15★ Weapons at Zig Shop
[*] New 13★ Units at Zig Shop
[*] 13★ Units can be have S-class Augments - S6, S7, S8
[/list]
 

A few of the new features and changes deserve to have a little bit more said about them, so let’s get started!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a24401cdca52abdfde9f658fde868505e37c48e8.png[/img]

[b]NEW STORY[/b]

After your victorious return from the battle in Alternate Dimension: Omega, the universe seems to be righting itself, as the massive Black Hole seems to have disappeared. The only remaining oddity left to address is the sudden appearance of someone bearing a striking resemblance to a recent acquaintance – who happens to call herself Shiva, Goddess of Annihilation. Outside of the forbidding name, perhaps most alarming is the fact that Photon Arts and Techniques appear to be totally ineffective at warding her, and her companions, off. Fortunately, her initial overture towards ARKS was brief, though its purpose was to flatly declare war.

Bolstered by an armada of her own, Shiva has deployed her forces in a standard formation – directly opposing Fleet Oracle. Though the battlespace is limitless, preparation time is not, and the most massive battle in the history of ARKS is about to begin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/67964f7324b39da2b8ecd587a24a27a60b49fe53.png[/img]

[h2][b]SCION CLASS - PHANTOM[/b][/h2]

A Scion Class, the Phantom adeptly uses Rods, Katanas, and Assault Rifles in a manner unique to their Class. But their advantage doesn’t end there, for they can quickly modify their Rod or Katana’s standard Photon Arts on the fly with the use of a Weapon Action, thus executing a [b]Shift Photon Art[/b] and increasing the variety of attacks they can perform. Even their Techniques, when executed with a Rod in hand, provide an additional [b]Technique Attack[/b].  


In the hands of a Phantom, the Phantom Assault Rifle is used to create [b]Phantom Bits[/b], allowing the Phantom to continue with their Attacks and Photon Arts while deployed Bits seek and detonate upon the target. Perhaps most impressive, subsequent attacks against enemies will apply a [b]Phantom Marker[/b], which detonates when struck with a Charged Weapon Action.

 
Finally, Phantoms can learn the skill [b]Phantom Time[/b], which extends the duration of their invulnerability when sidestepping and reduces their PP consumption by 20% for a short time. Using [b]Phantom Time Finish[/b] once the duration of Phantom Time is nearly expired will unleash a massive attack upon the Phantom’s enemies. As with all Scion Classes, you will need to level two Classes to level 75 before you are able to complete Officer Kofy’s Class Permit Trial unlocking the Phantom Class. Phantoms are also unable to select a Sub-Class, however other Classes can select Phantom as their Sub-Class.

[b]Notable Photon Arts of the Phantom include:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Rufkonzert[/b] - Rod Photon Art for Phantoms. Unleash a string of attacks and then let loose a shockwave. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
[*] [b]Wolkenkratzer[/b] - Katana Photon Art for Phantoms. Execute a drop attack accompanied by a shock wave. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
[*] [b]Verbrechen[/b] - Assault Rifle Photon Art for Phantoms. Launch a line of attack satellites as you move. Performing a Weapon Action changes the Photon Art.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/898352ecffddc1fcd87d187f9d97494d8425a2cd.png[/img]

[h2][b]SCION CLASS - ÉTOILE[/b][/h2]

Notable in the fields of Defense and Support skills, Étoiles shine quite brightly when in the thick of battle. Capable of wielding the Double Saber, which allows for increased aerial mobility; Soaring Blades, which grant them the ability to defend while still attacking; and Wands, which provide free movement while allowing the Étoile to continue with their attacks.
 

In the hands of an Étoile, the Double Saber grants the operative high mobility, special aerial abilities, and the ability to accumulate Focus through the Focus Gauge – which is spent automatically to help mitigate incoming damage. Naturally, this Focus can also be spent on an [b]Enhanced Attack[/b], so it’s up to the Étoile to determine the best use of their Focus at a given time. The Weapon Action of the Étoile Double Saber is called [b]Deflect[/b] and using it will activate a [b]Perfect Guard[/b]. Deflect can also be used to unleash a powerful counterattack. Perhaps most notable is the Étoile’s ability to use [b]Double Saber Skip Arts[/b], allowing them to tailor their attacks to specific parts of their Photon Arts.


Soaring Blades allow an Étoile to [b]Parry[/b] by using their Weapon Action. This allows them to block attacks from every direction, even when the Étoile is in the middle of a Photon Art. Étoile Soaring Blades also allow the use of the Focus Gauge, which can be spent on a powerful [b]Connect Attack[/b] upon reaching a certain level. Building the Focus Gauge even more will unleash a [b]Full Connect Attack[/b].


Perhaps the most favored weapon, the Étoile Wand provides the operative with high mobility and attacks that chain together naturally. Using the Weapon Action at the right time during the use of a Photon Art will release a [b]Focused Photon Art[/b], which may be smaller in scope, but far more powerful. Used on its own, the Weapon Action will activate [b]Charge Protect[/b], providing the Étoile with defense while moving. By expending the Étoile Focus Gauge, this defensive stance can be maintained longer. Once the Focus Gauge has been depleted to a certain level, a powerful attack known as a [b]Protect Release[/b] will occur and devastate the area surrounding the Étoile.
 

Naturally, as with the other Scion Classes, this Class is restricted to senior operatives who have reached Level 75 with two different Classes. Also, like the Phantom, Étoile can be chosen as a Sub-class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/898352ecffddc1fcd87d187f9d97494d8425a2cd.png[/img]

[b]Notable Photon Arts of the Scion include:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Light Wave[/b] – Soaring Blades Photon Art. Unleashes a barrage of blows that emit shockwaves and launches a Photon Blade that pierces the enemy.
[*][b] Black Hole Rapture[/b] – Wand Étoile Photon Art. Sucks up targets into an explosion. Attack changes depending on Weapon Actions.
[*] [b]Celestial Collide[/b] – Double Saber Photon Art. Release a giant Photon Blade into the enemy with a heel drop.
[/list]

[h2][b]NEW SUMMONER PETS – HERBIE AND VULCAN[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/7bb38bc5d64558f209c977287e50e6359055a34c.png[/img]

[u][b]Herbie[/b][/u] – An evolved form of Redran (though of the same Rarity), Herbie has increased DEX (+93 at Level 130). Herbie has a new personality type, that of GENIUS. When facing a Boss-type enemy, this personality will provide [b]increased PP recovery[/b], faster performance of Photon Arts, and increased Normal Attack damage[/b]. Though evolved from Redran, Herbie’s Photon Arts are slightly different in that [b]Laser[/b] affects fewer targets, the potency and range of [b]Mine[/b] are increased in exchange for a higher PP Cost, Slash yields higher damage at the cost of more PP, [b]Gravity[/b] requires less PP, and [b]Burst[/b] charges faster and requires less PP but also deals less damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b72473de6f6e54b24eb6ea406c6a47bdcab238fe.png[/img]

[u][b]Vulcan[/b][/u] – The evolved form of Synchro, its nature allows for higher damage with chained Photon Arts. It has an altered personality, however, and is considered [b]Aggressive[/b]. This personality reduces its Critical Hit Rate in exchange for greatly increased damage. It also has slightly [b]higher Dexterity, Defense, and HP[/b] than its lesser form. [b]Kick’s [/b]damage is greatly increased at the cost of more PP, [b]Fist[/b] deals increased damage, and [b]Bomb[/b] and [b]Strike[/b] do more damage compared to their Synchro counterparts.

[h2][b]NEW RECOMMENDED QUESTS – LEVEL UP QUESTS[/b][/h2]

There’s a new entry in the Recommended Quests at the Quest Counter – Level Up Quests! These will also reward a Special Present at the end of the Quest, in addition to providing an additional 200% EXP!

 
[h2][b]NEW COLLECTION FOLDERS[/b][/h2]

Earn your way towards your next upgrade!


[b]Legendary 15★ Collection Folder[/b]

That’s right Arks! Check out these [b]15★, +30 Enhancement Level Weapons![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fb0f644ddb0b2e3ff2543ff205c00f7948041b18.png[/img]


[u][b]14★ Eggs Collection 1[/b][/u]

Summoners, we heard you! Don’t miss this opportunity to earn a 14★ Pet Egg of your choosing!

[b]FEATURED PET EGGS[/b]
[list]
[*] Wanda Egg | 14★
[*] Trim S Egg | 14★
[*] Sally Egg | 14★
[*] Marron S Egg | 14★
[*] Melon Egg | 14★
[*] Viola S Egg | 14★
[*] Rappy Egg | 14★
[*] Synchro S Egg | 14★
[*] Jinga Egg | 14★
[*] Aero S Egg | 14★
[*] Popple Egg | 14★
[*] Redran S Egg | 14★
[*] Herbie Egg | 14★
[*] Vulcan Egg | 14★
[/list]

[h2][b]NEW ENEMY TYPES – LUMINMECH AND ULTRA HARD[/b][/h2]

Naturally, Shiva has some new baddies for operatives to play with. See below for the latest information ARKS HQ has received on them!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/52e68aaa72c5e2bcd777a250816f20e4bdab5734.png[/img]

[u][b]Luminmech[/b][/u]

Luminmech are enemies created and dispatched by Shiva, Goddess of Annhilation. Luminmech have high attack power, use heavy armor, and have unique skills that make them a very dangerous foe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0ae3514d732c2a0bfba4a361c3c71a301ffc48ea.png[/img]

[u][b]Ultra Enemies[/b][/u]

Ultra Enemies are Native inhabitants and Falspawn of each planet that have undergone an additional, corruption-induced transformation. These enemies will be encountered in [b]Ultra Hard Difficulty Quests[/b].

After dispatching some Ultra Enemies, operatives have reported that each has dropped a special [b]15★[/b] weapon, similar to those dropped in Risk Exploration quests.

[h2][b]NEW QUEST TYPE – RISK EXPLORATION[/b][/h2]

Expeditions may have become less challenging as you’ve become more powerful, but that doesn’t mean there aren’t enemies out there that will truly test your mettle! Risk Explorations are the next frontier that ARKS HQ would like you to explore, but be forewarned, because these quests are only available for those who aren’t afraid to take on Ultra Hard Quests!

It takes some time (3 days) for ARKS HQ to plan out which set of areas should be explored, and when, so these will not all be simultaneously be available, as normal Expedition Quests are. You can also expect to be more challenged by the random occurrence of Emergency Trials as well, as they’ll have more difficult goals under different conditions than those that have occurred elsewhere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/784e3bdea513e04314315104980e3caf4fde2c02.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c026e1417559ca38f7a75bdfdb3e2fdbfe411108.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW ZIG SHOP ITEM – KEY RIVALATE WEAPON SERIES[/b][/h2]

You can now exchange weapons for 15★ RIVALATE SERIES WEAPONS at the Zig Shop, provided you have the necessary materials, including a [b]Key Rivalate[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/279f316e9140d1aad4e8068e691e3b7670f29a26.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/99d6d69ea8e4e06d967652070753ff6bf468833c.png[/img]


[h2][b]WEAPON EXTENSION AND 13★ WEAPON CREATION[/b][/h2]

That weapon seemed perfect when you first got it, but now compared to some of the new items you’re picking up lately, it’s not so hot. The good news is that WEAPON EXTENSION Is now available in your Personal Quarters via the Crafting Terminal! Extending your (up to 12★) weapon can overwrite the standard stats with those of a selected recipe – once you’ve raised the weapon’s [b]Extension Level[/b] enough – with the maximum level being 12. The Enhancement Level, Augments, and Weapon Potentials will not be affected.


To Extend your weapon, you’ll need some materials, most of which can be attained by [b]Dismantling 7★ or higher equipment[/b] at the Crafting Terminal. As you Extend more items, you’ll attain Crafting Achievements, which will unlock additional, more powerful Recipes.


If you’re looking for an entirely new upgrade and the Rare Drop Rate has not favored you, you can now [b]craft 13★ weapons[/b] at the Crafting Terminal! These weapons can then be Extended up to Extension Level 8!

[h2][b]RISING WEAPONS BADGE 5[/b][/h2]

The next Rising Weapons Badge, and the wares that can be purchased with them, are here! Perhaps most notably, you can now purchase Sweets for your Pets and S-Grade Augments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/461d18fca62a3532b0f4a12474d096125cb49972.png[/img]

*By using the [b]Key Rivalate[/b] found in Mission Pass 11 or received as a Title Reward for achieving the Title of [b]Glass Guardian[/b], you can upgrade [b]Novel Series Weapons[/b] to [b]Rivalate Series[/b] Weapons.

 

[b]FEATURED SWEETS[/b]

[h2][b]ADDITIONAL ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h2]

[b]Balance adjustment – Hero[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Heroic Boost[/b] – The maximum and minimum values for power gain from this skill have been raised.
[*] [b]Hero Counter[/b]  – During Hero Counter, Heroic Boost has had its maximum power value increased.
[*] [b] Precision Attack Critical[/b]  – Critical rate has been increased.

[b]Quest Triggers added to Rising Weapons Badge 4 Exchange Shop[/b]

Quest Triggers up to Episode 5 have been added, e.g. Hostility Trigger, Unceasing Madness Trigger, Crimson Fellwyrm Trigger, etc.
 

[b]Unique Weapons Badge Exchange Shop - New and Sale items![/b]

[list]
[*] 14★ Ares Series Weapons are now available

New ARKS Missions – Time Attack Quests

[b]New Function available via the Scratch Ticket Prize List – Check Item Market Prices!

Account Character Creation limit increased to 30![/b]


We hope you’ve enjoyed this glimpse of the content in Episode 6, and hope you’ll join us for Episode 6 – when the real fun begins! See you in a Risk Exploration, Arks!

The Weapon Action of the Étoile Double Saber is called Deflect and using it will activate a Perfect Guard.
Deflect can also be used to unleash a powerful counterattack.
Perhaps most notable is the Étoile’s ability to use Double Saber Skip Arts, allowing them to tailor their attacks to specific parts of their Photon Arts.
Soaring Blades allow an Étoile to Parry by using their Weapon Action.
This allows them to block attacks from every direction, even when the Étoile is in the middle of a Photon Art.
Étoile Soaring Blades also allow the use of the Focus Gauge, which can be spent on a powerful Connect Attack upon reaching a certain level.
Building the Focus Gauge even more will unleash a Full Connect Attack.
Perhaps the most favored weapon, the Étoile Wand provides the operative with high mobility and attacks that chain together naturally.
Using the Weapon Action at the right time during the use of a Photon Art will release a Focused Photon Art, which may be smaller in scope, but far more powerful.
Used on its own, the Weapon Action will activate Charge Protect, providing the Étoile with defense while moving.
By expending the Étoile Focus Gauge, this defensive stance can be maintained longer.
Once the Focus Gauge has been depleted to a certain level, a powerful attack known as a Protect Release will occur and devastate the area surrounding the Étoile.
Naturally, as with the other Scion Classes, this Class is restricted to senior operatives who have reached Level 75 with two different Classes.
Also, like the Phantom, Étoile can be chosen as a Sub-class.
Light Wave – Soaring Blades Photon Art.
Unleashes a barrage of blows that emit shockwaves and launches a Photon Blade that pierces the enemy.
Black Hole Rapture – Wand Étoile Photon Art.
Sucks up targets into an explosion.
Attack changes depending on Weapon Actions.
Celestial Collide – Double Saber Photon Art.
Release a giant Photon Blade into the enemy with a heel drop.
NEW SUMMONER PETS – HERBIE AND VULCAN
Herbie – An evolved form of Redran (though of the same Rarity), Herbie has increased DEX (+93 at Level 130).
Herbie has a new personality type, that of GENIUS.
When facing a Boss-type enemy, this personality will provide increased PP recovery, faster performance of Photon Arts, and increased Normal Attack damage.
Vulcan – The evolved form of Synchro, its nature allows for higher damage with chained Photon Arts.
It has an altered personality, however, and is considered Aggressive.
This personality reduces its Critical Hit Rate in exchange for greatly increased damage.
It also has slightly higher Dexterity, Defense, and HP than its lesser form.
NEW RECOMMENDED QUESTS – LEVEL UP QUESTS
There’s a new entry in the Recommended Quests at the Quest Counter – Level Up Quests!
These will also reward a Special Present at the end of the Quest, in addition to providing an additional 200% EXP!
NEW COLLECTION FOLDERS
Legendary 15★ Collection Folder

NEW ENEMY TYPES – LUMINMECH AND ULTRA HARD
Luminmech are enemies created and dispatched by Shiva, Goddess of Annhilation.
Luminmech have high attack power, use heavy armor, and have unique skills that make them a very dangerous foe.
Ultra Enemies are Native inhabitants and Falspawn of each planet that have undergone an additional, corruption-induced transformation.
These enemies will be encountered in Ultra Hard Difficulty Quests.
After dispatching some Ultra Enemies, operatives have reported that each has dropped a special 15★ weapon, similar to those dropped in Risk Exploration quests.
NEW QUEST TYPE – RISK EXPLORATION
Risk Explorations are the next frontier that ARKS HQ would like you to explore, but be forewarned, because these quests are only available for those who aren’t afraid to take on Ultra Hard Quests!
It takes some time (3 days) for ARKS HQ to plan out which set of areas should be explored, and when, so these will not all be simultaneously be available, as normal Expedition Quests are.

You can also expect to be more challenged by the random occurrence of Emergency Trials as well, as they’ll have more difficult goals under different conditions than those that have occurred elsewhere.
NEW ZIG SHOP ITEM – KEY RIVALATE WEAPON SERIES
You can now exchange weapons for 15★ RIVALATE SERIES WEAPONS at the Zig Shop, provided you have the necessary materials, including a Key Rivalate.
WEAPON EXTENSION AND 13★ WEAPON CREATION
The good news is that WEAPON EXTENSION Is now available in your Personal Quarters via the Crafting Terminal!
Extending your (up to 12★) weapon can overwrite the standard stats with those of a selected recipe – once you’ve raised the weapon’s Extension Level enough – with the maximum level being 12.
To Extend your weapon, you’ll need some materials, most of which can be attained by Dismantling 7★ or higher equipment at the Crafting Terminal.
As you Extend more items, you’ll attain Crafting Achievements, which will unlock additional, more powerful Recipes.
If you’re looking for an entirely new upgrade and the Rare Drop Rate has not favored you, you can now craft 13★ weapons at the Crafting Terminal!
These weapons can then be Extended up to Extension Level 8!
RISING WEAPONS BADGE 5
The next Rising Weapons Badge, and the wares that can be purchased with them, are here!
Perhaps most notably, you can now purchase Sweets for your Pets and S-Grade Augments!
By using the Key Rivalate found in Mission Pass 11 or received as a Title Reward for achieving the Title of Glass Guardian, you can upgrade Novel Series Weapons to Rivalate Series Weapons.

notes.title: THANKSGIVING IN PSO2!
notes.content:
[b]It’s Turkey-time! Prepare yourselves (and your stomachs) for the Thanksgiving Event, coming November 11th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/85293638ba73925d92d3715799a7394c363e7734.jpg[/img]

Happy Thanksgiving, Arks! It is time to show our gratitude for those who fight to protect others, and naturally that includes operatives. The Ship has been decorated, special treats will be offered, and new holiday-themed items are available! Without further ado, let’s get into the content of the [i]THANKSGIVING EVENT[/i], starting [b]November 11th[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a5795f29497925a95619c8960145d724041098db.png[/img]
[h2][b]A CORNUCOPIA OF DECORATIONS![/b][/h2]
If you’re hungry for Thanksgiving décor, then you’re sure to be stuffed after visiting the Shopping Plaza of your Ship. ARKS HQ has really flown the coop with the Thanksgiving theme, and Rappy takes center stage (though in this case he’d probably prefer not to.) Oh, and the Medical Bay would like to remind operatives to not eat any of the display items, regardless of how good they look. 

[b]Begins:[/b] 11/11 (PST) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 12/08 (PST) (beginning of maintenance)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0998a792251a6f5af79ae50b28930c2f00f4ac9c.png[/img]
[h2][b]A FESTIVE (AND WELL-TIMED) GATHERING OF WINGED ONES[/b] [/h2]
A situation has arisen where winged creatures and Falspawn are gathering en masse on the Floating Continent of Amduskia. Little do they know, this is not the best time to be encouraging an ARKS hunt, as Xia has quite a few mouths to feed for her upcoming feast. It may be a good idea to stop by and visit her in the Shopping Plaza before heading to the Gateway ship to take on this quest. Operatives are to head to the Floating Continent and determine the reason this flock is gathering. You’ll have 30 minutes to complete your investigation, and each enemy defeated will reward you not only with combat experience, but with points, with 1126 Quest Points being required for quest completion. 

Due to the somewhat uneven terrain, ARKS HQ has deployed a few [b]Catapults[/b] and [b]Dash Panels[/b] that we had left over from the Summer training event. When at a Dash Panel, pressing “E” will temporarily enable high-speed movement to cross terrain. Touching another Dash Panel will extend the effect. You can jump or kick while under the effects of the Dash Panel, and the kick can be powered up 3 times by chaining the use of Dash Panels. Catapults will send you soaring in the direction indicated. Be sure to explore every inch, as some Catapults may take you to otherwise unreachable areas! So get out there and pluck some feathers so you can get your [i]* TURKEY LEG[/i] weapon camo, which works for all weapons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/530b0d2ef014d8f53b50a6fb10a97490ac1d7294.png[/img]

[h2][b]GRATEFUL XIA[/b][/h2]
Xia wants to make sure that those on Fleet Oracle feel appreciated during Thanksgiving, so she’d like to host a feast for all! The problem is, she’s a bit short on event staff, and could use an extra pair of hands. There are a few errands she’d like for you to run, and in exchange you’ll receive [i]THANKSGIVING BADGE 2020[/i], which can be used to purchase some fun Thanksgiving-themed items and [i]RISING WEAPONS BADGE 4[/i]! These badges can be exchanged as currency for weapons and other items on the second floor of the Shopping Plaza. As if all this wasn’t good enough, Thanksgiving Badge 2020 can also be used to purchase Roasted Turkey! Roasted Turkey is a consumable item that provides a +50% Triboost effect for 10 minutes! Be sure to get your fill, because these items have an expiration date!

Rising Weapons Badge 4 | Currency

Remember, in sufficient number, [b]Rising Weapons Badge 4[/b] can be exchanged in the Shopping Plaza for materials needed to create a [b]★[/b]15 weapon!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/47bc3b3008907e428adf5ab8d7f833bb5e3787ee.png[/img]
[h2][b]TURKEY (RAPPY) LEG, ANYONE?[/b][/h2]
Rappy loves Thanksgiving too! Unfortunately, his costume reminds us that he is a feathered fowl. Those who enjoy the cuteness of Rappys definitely won’t be disappointed! Don’t let that cuteness stop you though, since these special Rappys have a chance to drop almost any of the Rappy Suit Mini outfits!

Rappy Suit Mini: Lovey | Outfit, Unisex, All Races


[h2][b]LIMITED-TIME ARKS MISSIONS[/b][/h2]
In the process of completing campaigns or gathering materials, don’t forget to take a look at your [i]ARKS MISSIONS[/i] List every now and then, but especially for this event. ARKS HQ has added a few extra objectives for operatives to complete, and the rewards range from some [b]Roasted Turkey[/b] to [b]Thanksgiving Badge 2020[/b], which can be used to purchase items from Xia’s special shop. If you need a refresher on ARKS Missions, check out [url=https://pso2.com/news/blogs/arksmissions]this[/url] article.


[h3][b]ADDITIONAL CONTENT COMING NOVEMBER 11TH![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a13ccf0e928710014c2910dd0af21308488e5369.png[/img]
[h2][b]SURVEYING A PARALLEL WORLD[/b][/h2]
Perhaps the most extreme Ultimate Quest that any operative can undertake, [i]SURVEY: REMNANTS OF A PARALLEL WORLD[/i] is not for the faint of heart. Only senior-ranking Arks (those above level 80 on both Main and Sub – Class) should attempt this mission, as it is to be done solo. That’s right, on your own, as the area is too unstable to allow for greater numbers of operatives. Your supplies will be limited such that Scape Dolls or Half Scape Dolls won’t save you. When the 15 minute time limit is up, or should an operative become incapacitated, participants will be extracted and the quest will be considered a failure. You’ll have 10 attempts at this quest each day, with the counter resetting at 5:00 AM (PST). A successful quest still consumes one attempt. Remaining, unused attempts do not transfer over to the next day.

Your mission briefing is fairly simple. Leadership has received signals coming from this specific sector of Alternate Dimension: Omega, and their magnitude indicate that the entity responsible is equal to the strength of the Profound Darkness. Initial probes have shown that the area is layered, with a stronger enemy present on each successive level. You will not be able to traverse the levels freely though, as defeating the prime enemy on a level will result in an ARKS extraction for a medical evaluation, mandated by HQ.


[h2][b]Powerful Augments[/b][/h2]
The energy of the sector seems to have influenced the items available to those who explore it, and some cursory explorations have yielded the following.

[h3][b] Available Augments[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6e01c6dee9ec9b03c0b76dfa7c1e3cfba4473aba.png[/img]

[h3][b]Featured Rewards[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c4caf1c00cec998ed7ca07210301b8562c8d2240.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/4976b0d6f2b80c7080c2e463412c9f28ed9edf62.png[/img][/url]
Back / Mask of Vane | ★12, Unit


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/4eea09b63691dc083e27a48a9040913d2ca1e1d2.png[/img]
[h2][b]PHANTASY STAR UNIVERSE(S)[/b][/h2]
Ethan and Karen have taken their interplanetary patrolling to another world, and that’s not just a saying – they really did – since they wound up on Fleet Oracle. They’re going to need some assistance in finding a way back to their world, and so far they have no idea where to start looking. As they’re unfamiliar with the hazards of the ARKS sphere of influence, they’re going to need an escort, and you’re just the operative to do it! Not only will you have the pleasure of their company (permanently, as you can receive their [b]Partner Cards[/b]), but you may also wind up with some weapon camos too! Check out what you’ll receive by completing their [b]Client Orders[/b]!

[h3][b]Featured Rewards
[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/05da8d9ee9936168a05772931e7b50cfa6809b9c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f8acd72c1eec159b5cd8ce2d600bab06d83ee309.png[/img][/url]
* Giant Slicer  | Weapon Camo

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/48f6db8f3a1c122bec6d901d1c4c8c5ea8e7f1f0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/e528ac874785262e60683ede281f8211b8787afe.png[/img][/url]
* Crea Doubles | Weapon Camo

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/5ae18eb35cba3ac0726a29fc557b652db2a0e448.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/91c6852a7ee1f9fd02f478632eaea69650720c83.png[/img][/url]
* Dagger of Seraphi | Weapon Camo


[h2][b]★15 STAR WEAPON EXCHANGE[/b][/h2]
That’s right, they’re here – well, at Zig’s Shop actually. ARKS HQ is proud to announce the availability of 3 types of [b]★[/b]15 weapons; the [i]OPHISTIA SERIES[/i], the [i]TRAILBLAZER XION SERIES[/i], and the [i]ATLAS EX SERIES[/i]. In order to acquire one of these weapons, you have a short list of materials to procure, though some of the items may require an upgrade of their own. After all, in order to get something, you have to give something, and in this case it’s a template from which Zig can work. Each series requires the submission of one (or more) [b]★[/b]14 weapons from specific weapon series that are enhanced to [b]+35 Enhancement Level[/b]. These Enhancement Levels were not achieved in vain, however, as the resulting [b]★[/b]15 weapon will retain them. For more information on the specifics of [b]★[/b]15 weapon exchange at the Zig Shop, check out [url=https://pso2.com/news/announcements/star15weapons]this[/url] article.

We hope you’re as excited as we are to share the Thanksgiving spirt! So pass the Volcanic Caves Pumpkin pie and dig in!

 

- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: HALLOWEEN IN PSO2!
notes.content:
[b]“Boo!” to you, from PSO2! We didn’t want Arks going Personal Quarters door to Personal Quarters door and possibly disturbing tired operatives, so we figured we’d throw our own Halloween Event![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/7861e62b5ca2e74a9be79e96b761cb085c9ab779.jpg[/img]

Welcome to a Phantasy Star Halloween, Arks! After visiting Earth during previous quests, ARKS has decided to celebrate a beloved holiday of the inhabitants of Earth, which led to the [i]HALLOWEEN EVENT[/i]! There’ll be candy-themed weapons and other fun things to find and explore. The new Urgent Quest [i]TRICK OR TREAT[/i]!, the introduction of the Expedition [i]BEWITCHED WOODS[/i], costumed Rappys and Emperappys, decked-out Xia, and more, await operatives of Fleet Oracle! Check out the individual sections below to learn more about each facet of the Halloween Event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/89ca85539ce02632dcaee49aa32c17e1c8355394.png[/img]

[h2][b]DÉCOR THEME: SPOOK-TOBER![/b][/h2]
Your ship’s Gateway Area has been decked out in Halloween-themed decorations, so that operatives are kept in the Halloween-spirit while dancing, showing off costumes, and of course, accepting Quests from the Quest Counter. For those who spend more time in the Shopping Plaza, pumpkins and autumnal-themed items have been put on display. Please refrain from carving any pumpkins, however. 

[b]Begins:[/b] 10/13  (PDT) (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 11/10 (PDT) (beginning of maintenance) 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0423ecb907e7a5be4af6eb6f28fc5ea09d7478f5.png[/img]

[h2][b]PARTY CRASHERS[/b][/h2]
In the limited-time Urgent Quest, [i]TRICK OR TREAT[/i], you’ll need to help clear out an area on Lillipa that was to be a party venue for Arks. However, rampaging Falspawn and Automata apparently decided to crash the party, and ARKS HQ needs 8 operatives to take on the role of bouncer (role, not class) to eject the unwelcome guests.  The festival was going to include the use of Turrets and Energy Tanks (don’t ask how) so the presence of these should be helpful in clearing out the interlopers. Those of you who come wearing something special will be eligible for a [i]PSE OUTFIT BONUS EFFECT[/i]! This boost will net operatives [b]increased EXP gain[/b] as well as an [b]increased rare item drop rate[/b] for the duration of their current instance of [b]Trick or Treat[/b]! So before heading to the Quest Counter, check to see if you have any of the items in [url=https://pso2.com/news/announcements/scarewear1014]this[/url] article!

We’re certain at least a few Arks will prefer this over the Lobby as the new gathering place! Just don’t be spooked if a few friendly ghosts prefer it too!

As you take on quests, you’ll be informed when you’ve completed a task and the Bingo square number will be briefly displayed at the bottom of your screen. Your ARKS Bingo Card can be accessed through the main menu, then selecting “Current Events” and “ARKS Bingo Card.” To view what tasks you have yet to complete, click on the name of the ARKS Bingo Card–in this case “Halloween 2020 Bingo”–and select “View Details.” The tab that displays by default is named “View Bingo Card,” and this is where you can view remaining squares to be completed. The other Tab is named “Bingo Completion Reward” and this is where you view what rewards you have yet to receive. Finally, the number of times you get a “BINGO” –all squares completed in a straight line, may or may not include the “Free” space in the middle– may qualify you for one of the rewards listed below!

[b]Ends:[/b] 11/10 (PDT) (beginning of maintenance)

Ever fancy a walk in the woods, at night? If so, then check out the spooky new Expedition, [b]Bewitched Woods[/b], which fits perfectly with the Halloween theme. A massive, winding forest has appeared on Omega and it’s up to you (and up to 11 other operatives) to chart its paths and determine its hazards. Minotaurqz, Omega Salamanders, Omega Dark Falz, and others are hiding in the gnarled trees, so beware of potential ambushes. This Expedition isn’t all risk and no reward though, as the items these enemies have upon their persons are often of great value; items like the [i]CHAOS MALOSSISTONE[/i] (used in Zig products for Supernatural weapons), for instance. ARKS HQ has mandated that in order to venture into these frightful woods, you’ll need to be at least level 55 and have cleared a particular Client Order. Check out some of the potential items that may drop while in the Bewitched Woo:ds!

notes.title: SUMMER IN PSO2!
notes.content:
[b]If you’re looking for fun in the sun, look no further than the Summer Event in PSO2! Check out this article for more details![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c8857d622edbcd70f4cb707d9c6e6091b0af8a44.jpg[/img]

Arks around the globe have come to PSO2, along with Summer! It’s a fabulous time to celebrate the beachy weather and new recruits, and so ARKS HQ has decided to hold a Summer Event from[b] August 5th to September 2nd[/b]! Items of interest during this time include [b]new Urgent Quests, Summer-related Client Orders[/b] from [b]Xia[/b], a[b] décor [/b][b]overhaul [/b]in various areas, [b]Summer BINGO[/b], and more! Features in the event may reward powerful new weapons and some unique cosmetic items! Without further ado, let’s dive into some of the features coming in PSO2’s Summer Event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/3a696b1910e9bdc9f765d8436b23a65e16e0a052.png[/img]


[h2][b]SUMMER-TIME BOOST[/b][/h2]

The heat may discourage some from wanting to train, so ARKS HQ has decided to implement some [b]Ship-Wide and Extreme Quest Boosts[/b] to encourage Arks to get out and enjoy the summer. If you’re looking for an item upgrade or some experience gain, then now is the time to pack your calendar with missions and quests!


[b]SHIP-WIDE BOOSTS![/b]
[b]Begins:[/b] 8/5 (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 8/12, 12:59 AM (PDT)

[list]
[*]EXP Earned +50%
[*]Rare Item Drop Rate +50%
[/list]

[h2][b]EXTREME QUEST BOOSTS![/b][/h2]
[b]Begins:[/b] 8/5 (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 8/12, 12:59 AM (PDT)

[list]
[*]Meseta Earned +50%
[/list]

[i]*Rates of Boost Effects may change per orders from ARKS HQ.
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/09c388fb2838ea0d77d1c7787497996955f328f9.png[/img]

[h2][b]DÉCOR THEME:  FUN IN THE SUN[/b][/h2]

ARKS HQ wanted to not only give operatives some pool-time, but bring the real feeling of summer to the Ships. That’s why you’ll notice that a couple of new objects have been added here and there throughout your resident Ship. From coconut trees in the Gate Area, to a water slide in the Shopping Plaza, we think you’ll be reaching for sun-tan lotion and smelling the grill as soon as you see the new décor!

[b]Begins:[/b] 8/5 (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 9/1 (at the beginning of maintenance)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/048c4b376b21c1571a81281248454a8c12bbfd2e.png[/img]
[h2][b]FRANCA'S (BEACH) CAFÉ[/b][/h2]

Franca has decided to try out a new look for her Café, and all Arks are invited to stop by and check out the new theme! If you’re looking for the perfect backdrop for your selfies, then look no further than the beach huts in the surf! They even have some strategically placed points to pose for the perfect pic! Since it takes quite a while to move furniture around, Franca’s Café décor will be sticking around for a bit longer, until [b]September 30th[/b]! So you’ve got plenty of time to soak up the sun!

[b]Begins:[/b] 8/5 (end of maintenance)
[b]Ends:[/b] 9/29 (at the beginning of maintenance)

[h2][b]SHE WORE AN...[/b][/h2]

[i]XIA[/i] will be making another appearance, and she has some tasks for operatives to perform (naturally in the form of Client Orders.) She’s got a lofty goal for the summer, and needs your help!

[h3][b]Featured Reward[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b636e9df7725d82efb5018e111bd5ce46eb3375f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/627c871f9f9fcabb40fc5b7a996f05170aaca168.png[/img][/url]
* Assault Mikoshi | Weapon Camo, Assault Rifle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0da2968c9491f58a63af5ea0065a1bb13fd60195.png[/img]

[h2][b]BEACH WARS![/b][/h2]

If you’ve ever run through sand, then you know it can be excellent for those looking to train. We’re willing to bet that you’ve probably never trained by running through sand while fighting Falspawn though, and ARKS HQ thinks that’s just what’s required to ensure our operatives are in fighting shape for the summer. This exercise will require operatives to join squads of 11 other Arks while battling Falspawn in the surf and sand. The exercise will be deemed “completed” after the squad has amassed a total of 800 points, though the total allowable quest time is limited to 30 minutes. Preliminary runs of this exercise have netted a few interesting rewards, which are displayed below. 

Due to the warm weather, Arks are encouraged to dress appropriately for the location, and if they do they will gain a [b]PSE Outfit Bonus effect[/b] for the duration they are in the attire and the Beach Wars Urgent Quest, visit [url=https://pso2.com/news/announcements/beachwarsbeachwear2020]this[/url] this page to know what you should wear! Effects experienced thus far have been increased EXP gain and an increased rare item drop rate.

[h2][b]Featured Rewards[/b][/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/79e72facba4c0062710ec86157d4d937b1f9c552.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/21240473738be239abcb84001e7870f4543c22b1.png[/img][/url]
Aura Delacque | ★13, Wired Lance

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/568cfce25be74693bb9d7ee2ddfc9860e51766c8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/6be259e66918d265a8ef1d504a06bfd3dd9e2916.png[/img][/url]
Aura Legars | ★13, Assault Rifle

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/90d14103cc6736529c907cc700f262b68e9a0119.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/8e3dfff3210b33b2d688c44f4e20baaf9240a8c6.png[/img][/url]
Aura Estur | ★13, Rod

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b9905a4cbb5b78f6aad2e7dc6ad294d553742308.png[/img]
[h2][b]RAPPY AND NYAU'S BEACHY LOOK[/b][/h2]

Rappy and Nyau are also looking to stay cool for the summer, and recent reports have indicated their attire has changed to reflect the season. Of course, their nature hasn’t changed, so Arks are directed to carry out their previous orders in regards to their destruction. Reports have indicated that they are carrying a few different things lately, so operatives may be able to recover the below listed items after their dispatch.

[h3][b]Featured Rewards[/b][/h3]

* Let’s Go Summer | Weapon Camo, Wired Lance

Get ready for Bingo, Arks! Just sign up for the “Beach Wars!” Urgent Quest and begin eradicating Falspawn and incapacitating Oceanids. As you go, you’ll be informed when you’ve completed a task and the Bingo square number will be briefly displayed at the bottom of your screen. notes.title: CHALLENGE OTHERS IN THE BATTLE ARENA!
notes.content:
[b]Spending your free time in the training ring may not seem like as much fun as the Casino, but with the Battle Arena it will be! See this article for more details about this exciting feature coming to PSO2 NA on August 5th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b38f30f1050029b4ed7ed0b2d2ad2a62ea629a3e.jpg[/img]

That’s right Arks. Want to test your mettle against your fellow operatives, or sharpen your “adapt-and-conquer” skills? If so then you’re in luck, because the [i]BATTLE ARENA[/i] has arrived with Episode 4!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d24ca9233a69037ad4d98d64b222a469ea0930a9.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW ARKS ON THE BLOCK[/b][/h2]
Your PvP experience will begin by using the Block Transporter to take you to the [i]BATTLE LOBBY[/i] on the [i]UNIVERSAL SHIP[/i]. Yes, you heard that correctly. The Universal Ship is a Ship accessible by all Arks, regardless of their home Ship. Players from different Ships can thus play together—or against each other-- in the Battle Arena or Challenge Quests. Navigation to the Universal Ship can be accomplished via the Quest Counter or by using the Teleporter.

[h2][b]A NEW PVP EXPERIENCE, EVERY TIME[/b][/h2]
In addition to being matched with different people to test your skills against, each PvP experience will also see you using different Photon Arts, Techniques, and weapons that are all particular to the combat area (map) you selected. As in Challenge Quests, you do not bring Mags, Units, Weapons, Class habits, Photon Arts, or Techniques from your home Ship to the Battle Block; just the outfit or layering-wear on your back and your will to prevail.  You are dubbed a “Battle Warrior,” and the equipment given to you at the start of each match will be random. Depending on your success in the arena, you’ll earn [i]BATTLE COIN [/i]and [i]ARENA POINTS[/i]. Battle Coins can be traded for very rare items at the [i]BATTLE COIN EXCHANGE SHOP[/i], while Arena Points will determine your [i]BATTLE RANK[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/e83bed4ad9056067b389cdae2b76388055ad9fe6.png[/img]

[h2][b]WHERE DO YOU RANK?[/b][/h2]
All Operatives are ranked based on their total Arena Points earned between 7:00 AM (PDT) on the 1st of each month and 7:00 AM (PDT) on the 1st of the following month. Beginning at 7:00 AM (PDT) on the 1st of the current month, operatives can receive their Ranking Rewards from the [b]ARKS League Officer[/b] on their Ship. Ranking Rewards usually consist of [i]STAR GEMS [/i](SG) and can be seen below. You can also view your own Battle Ranking Information by utilizing the Main Menu, then highlighting Content Information, and then selecting Battle Arena Information. The Battle Lobby also features a Battle Monument where you can view overall Battle Ranking information. Battle Rank is determined by accrued Arena Points (ARP), and correspond to the the ranks shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/80132dfa931c2bd97de1e1c98da656586923f147.png[/img]

[h2][b]TO RANK, OR NOT TO RANK[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Ranked Matches[/b] are random battles, where you’ll be randomly matched with ARKS Operatives from any block in the Battle Lobby, based on an operative’s BATTLE RANK. Battle Ranks are determined according to the total Arena Points that an operative possesses, with those who win more often in Ranked Matches being likely to be of higher Battle Rank. In these Matches, you cannot choose your opponents, but you will acquire Battle Coins, Reward Items, and your Arena Points will be affected by the outcome. The higher an operative’s Battle Rank is, the more Battle Coins they will receive when a battle ends. Also, those with higher Battle Ranks will find themselves receiving more extravagant rewards when the ranking period is done.

[*][b]Password Matches[/b] allow you to enjoy private battles with friends and other operatives by making password entry required in order to join. Therefore, you can choose who you battle. However, in these Matches you will not earn Battle Coins or Arena Points.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/a028d46f2ec1ea3854e9c519b46ebaecb3ee3c23.png[/img]

[h2][b]MULTIPLE MODES TO CONQUER
[/b][/h2]As if all this wasn’t exciting enough, ARKS HQ isn’t just going to throw you all together in one type of melee. Oh no, you’ll have the choice of battling in [i]EMBLEM SCRAMBLE[/i] or [i]4 VS 4 VR ARENA[/i], with the winner being declared after the allotted amount of time has passed.

[list]
[*][b]Emblem Scramble [/b]consists of 12 operatives who selected the quest at the same time on the selected Field (Map). The operatives will be split into 2 teams. Operatives cannot select their opponents or allies. Each operative will earn [i]EMBLEM POINTS[/i] and when the allotted time has passed, the team with the most total Emblem Points will win! Teams will each consist of 6 Arks, and weapons are randomized. When an operative is defeated, the vanquisher will steal 10% of the of vanquished player’s points.

[*][b]4 VS 4 VR Arenas[/b] can only be selected when selecting Password Matches. The rules are the same as a normal Emblem Scramble, with the team who collects the most Emblem Points being declared the winner and teams consisting of four players. There are five possible weapons you can use: swords, assault rifles, rods, jet boots, and bows.
[/list]

[h2][b]SHOW ME THE REWARDS[/b][/h2]
[i]BATTLE COIN BARTERER RALAF[/i], on the second level of the Shopping Plaza, has a few neat items available for the right amount of Battle Coins. Here are a few!

[h3][b]Battle Coin Rewards[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c78e428b5e6672edb031b5b81ba953e519070a5b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/bce17a72fc1667a46089bff712e4edd27c51ba88.png[/img][/url]
Rappy Suit Mini | Outfit, Unisex, All Races

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/833afcd16e66706212872a8e92cb12e8b928fe72.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/9ddb954505a20fb3cc9889a6a5b87f0ad9e9491f.png[/img][/url]
* Battle Twin Daggers | Weapon Camo, Twin Daggers

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0a68f2b2835cd09605bcf5c340053a8637a99a38.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/14bae9951709808135086223b2106a3cb859fa3d.png[/img][/url]
Rappy Makeup | Makeup

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/163342f5ca2452b12c1969651fe37483d22d4bc0.png[/img]
436: Ninja


The Battle Arena is just one more feature ARKS HQ is thrilled to introduce to PSO2 NA alongside Episode 4, and we can’t wait to hear of the heroic feats that are sure to take place during these brawls! See you in the Battle Lobby, Arks!


- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: LEVEL UP FASTER WITH BONUS QUESTS!
notes.content:
[b]Ready to power through a couple of levels? The prospect is much less daunting when you know that Bonus Quests are coming on August 5th! Read this article for more details![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/dbd241d3a628f57facded04fa73a2bd94ab03522.jpg[/img]

Feel like going on a solo-adventure to a land of bountiful [b]EXP, Meseta[/b], and [b]Rare Item Drops[/b]? If so, then you should be thrilled to know that [i]BONUS QUESTS[/i] are arriving in PSO2 NA on [b]August 5th[/b]! These quests require the consumption of specific [i]BONUS KEYS[/i], which are often awarded to operatives by ARKS HQ for various reasons. To learn more about Bonus Keys, read on Arks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/15d0f99d077789133f6f9843f6aea42ea40c9d02.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]WHERE DO THEY COME FROM
[/b][/h2]
ARKS HQ rewards operatives who perform exceptionally well, so one way to have a chance at Bonus Keys is to [b]clear Recommended Quests at A Rank or better[/b]. There’s a reason ARKS HQ wants you to do these quests, so it behooves them to reward you for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/0615d182379092f6932d2eb5071f4e9144815036.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]WHERE DO THEY GO[/b][/h2]
Bonus Keys are consumed upon the start of the quest. If you disconnect from the server or abandon the quest, the Key will not be returned, so make sure you’re ready.

[h2][b]TIMING IS EVERYTHING[/b][/h2]
The goal of Bonus Quests is to take your enemies down quickly. This will help you earn the largest amount of [b]EXP[/b], [b]Meseta[/b], and [b]items[/b]. Give this goal, these Bonus Quests will have Time limits of usually 10 minutes (some are 4 minutes). There are no level restrictions, so you can jump into them right away. However, these must be undertaken as solo ventures, so no Alliance members or Partner characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/d656b2938bb280ead0ba4558d73f778169d20b81.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]THE GOODS[/b][/h2]
A great variety of items can be found in these quests, besides weapons and units with a tendency to be on the rarer side. Such items can include crafting materials such as minerals and jewels from various planets. Some Arks have even reported receiving STAR GEMS and ASTRACITE after completion of these quests. Astracite, of course, can be exchanged with [b]Astracite Exchanger Nautbraugher[/b] on the second floor of the Shopping Plaza.


 That’s it Arks! See you at the Quest Counter!


- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: PSO2 ON STEAM: HOW TO LINK YOUR ACCOUNT
notes.content:
[b]Ready to bring your PSO2 experience to Steam? Or want the ability to play through Windows 10, Steam, or from your couch with an Xbox One? If so, then check out this must-read article to learn about linking your Steam and Xbox Live accounts![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/fba320a66eba799b6d918786375932123030a77e.jpg[/img]

Fleet Oracle has gained a few new bells and whistles to add to the pool of features Arks are already familiar with. Perhaps most notably, there’s a new way to drive your experience of Phantasy Star Online 2–using Steam! That’s right operatives, that “other PC platform” has arrived. Along with the release of the Steam platform of PSO2, an account-linking feature has been added that will allow accounts used on Xbox One and Windows 10 to be played on Steam, therefore preserving your past play-time.

[i][b]ATTENTION:[/b] Do not start Phantasy Star Online 2 on a new platform until you fully understand this account-linking process. Creating a character/setting up a Player ID on a new platform is [u]irreversible[/u] and you will not be able to link your account after the fact.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/55c650c98506714d3d5fdec6367d7ebf6d45b266.jpg[/img]

[h2]LINKING YOUR ACCOUNTS[/h2]
There are two ways to link your Xbox Live and Steam accounts; initiating the process from the Steam platform, or from the Xbox One or Windows 10 platform. In each case, [u]you’ll begin the process from the platform that you have been using[/u]. We’ll outline the process for both.

[b]If you’d like to [u]begin using the Steam platform[/u] to play PSO2 and want to link your Xbox One or Windows 10 account:[/b]

[list]
[*]From the Support Menu within the Start Menu of the Windows 10 or Xbox One version of PSO2, select the option to issue an account-linking code. This code will expire after 15 minutes.
[*]After launching PSO2 on the Steam platform, select your Ship and then enter the code from the previous step. [i][b]Please be careful:[/b] you can only use this code when setting up your account on a new platform for the first time. Do not create a new character/set up a Player ID before linking your account.[/i]
[*]Success! The operative can now play using the same PSO2 save data on either their Xbox Live or Steam Account ID.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/4588716b27c292a70aa113bc70fefd2d89f550d4.jpg[/img]

[b]If you’d like to [u]begin using the Xbox One or Windows 10 platform[/u] to play PSO2 and want to link your Steam account:[/b]

[list]
[*]From the Support Menu within the Start Menu of the Steam platform of PSO2, select the option to issue an account-linking code. This code will expire after 15 minutes.
[*]After launching PSO2 on Windows 10 or Xbox One, select your Ship and then enter the code from the previous step.[i] [b]Please be careful: [/b]you can only use this code when setting up your account on a new platform for the first time. Do not create a new character/set up a Player ID before linking your account.[/i]
[*]Success! The operative can now play using the same PSO2 save data on either their Xbox Live or Steam account.
[/list]

[i]*Entering the account-linking code is only possible during the first-time log-in when using the new platform.
**The same account-linking code cannot be used more than twice.
***If the first account-linking code is not used, and a new one is issued, only the newest account-linking code will be active.
****If a user inputs the account-linking code incorrectly, 10 times in a row, after the 10th time the user will not be able to link accounts until 24 hours have passed. This measure is for the safety of your account.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f1149ed3d524204dc71630c9f2dfc16941ea154d.jpg[/img]

[h2]UNLINKING YOUR ACCOUNT FROM YOUR SECONDARY PLATFORM[/h2]

You cannot unlink your account from the first platform that you used to play PSO2. [b]This process is non-reversible, so make sure it’s what you really want, operative![/b] In each case, you’ll begin the process from the secondary platform you would like to discontinue using. We’ll outline the process for both.

[b]If you’d like to [u]discontinue usage of the Steam platform and it is not the original platform you used to connect to PSO2:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Log-in to PSO2 from the Steam platform using the Steam account that you’d like to Unlink.
[*]Select “Unlink Account” from the Start Menu of PSO2.
[*]Confirm your desire to Unlink your accounts by entering the specified key in the confirmation window and selecting “Yes”.
[*]Your PSO2 save data on your Steam account will be deleted.
[/list]
[b]If you’d like to [u]discontinue usage of the Windows 10 or Xbox One platform and it is not the original platform your used to connect to PSO2:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Log-in to PSO2 from the Windows 10 or Xbox One platform using the Xbox Live account that you’d like to Unlink.
[*]Select “Unlink Account” from the Start Menu of PSO2.
[*]Confirm your desire to Unlink your accounts by entering the specified key in the confirmation window and selecting “Yes”.
[*]Your PSO2 save data on your Xbox Live account will be deleted.
[/list]


We’re thrilled to bring operatives together through these different platforms, as well as enlist the aid of Arks from an additional 33 countries! [b]August 5th [/b]marks the beginning of not only the newest Episode in Phantasy Star Online 2, but the birth of an expanded PSO2 Community as well, and we couldn’t be more excited! See you in the Lobby, Arks!

- The PSO2 Team

notes.title: WHAT’S NEW IN EPISODE 4
notes.content:
[b]Ready for Episode 4, but still trying to figure out what you’re most excited about? Check out this article for a review of the features and content arriving in our first episode release in the West![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/95abe5e56a20ed62c22339ccfa15708d2385e3c5.jpg[/img]

The time is finally here, Arks! The next major content update, [u]EPISODE 4[/u], arrives on [b]August 5th![/b]

Give those arms a stretch after coming out of Cryo-sleep and make sure you don’t feel any lingering effects of corruption from your encounter with the Profound Darkness in Episode 3. About 2 years has passed, and Fleet Oracle has a new commander. Some oddly-behaving Arks have recently been spotted among the Ships, and Commander Ulc needs you to investigate to ensure they are who they say they are. She’s also tasked you with finding out if there’s any relation between the odd Arks and the recently discovered planet, Earth.

Under the new command, a few things have been added, and ARKS HQ wants to make sure you’re apprised of what to expect when Episode 4 arrives. Please keep your hands and arms inside the Gateway Ship, as we start off on a brief tour of the included content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2be5c0ddeb9e8948634a486f62d1725726d84d9c.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]WHAT’S NEW[/b][/h2]
Some of the new changes and features include:

[list]
[*]Global access for an additional 33 countries
[*]Player Level cap increased to 80
[*]Photon Art and Technique Levels increased to 17
[*]New Skills available from Player Level 76 to 80
[*]Introduction of PvP in the BATTLE ARENA
[*]New PSO2 Friend List, separate from Xbox Live Friend List
[*]Character slot maximums have increased to 20
[*]New ARKS Missions
[*]Universal Ship for Battle Arena and Challenge Quests
[*]BONUS Quests for huge amounts of EXP, Meseta, and material items!
[*]New Seasonal Events
[*]New Alliance Quarters, including Tokyo, Battleship, and Lunar Surface
[*]Characters from the Anime series of Phantasy Star Online 2 will appear on the Ship, and can join your party after completing specific Client Orders!
[*]Exciting new Titles to earn
[*]New enemy types to challenge
[*]New quest types
[*]New areas to explore
[*]Preview your purchases in the Fresh Finds Shop
[*]Send your Material Items automatically to the Storehouse
[*]Season 6 of the Mission Pass
[/list]

A few of the new features and changes deserve to have a little bit more said about them, so let’s get started!


[h2][b]CRAFTING
[/b][/h2]
[u]CRAFTING [/u]has finally come to PSO2! This will allow operatives to customize armor, Techniques, and Photon Arts! Crafting can be accessed via the Personal Terminal in your Personal Quarters or from the Mini-Room. Each crafting type will have a “Crafting Level,” which can be increased by completing Crafting Achievements. Increasing your level can impart bonus effects when crafting!

To summarize the benefits:

[list]
[*]Equipment Extension (Units) allows you to re-write the basic values of a Unit
[*]Customize the abilities, speed, and potency of Photon Arts
[*]Customize the potency, speed, number of hits, or range of Techniques
[*]Add a Timed Ability to a Unit, such as one that increases a recovery or attack power effect
[*]Dismantle unwanted items and receive the material items for crafting
[*]Daily Crafting Orders will arrive
[*]Receive Crafting Orders from other operatives
[/list]
 
There’s a lot to learn, operative, so make sure to check it out for yourself!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/deb7b195794fb208b683f6901d1432812866ad6a.jpg[/img]
 

[h2][b]A NEW PLANET TO EXPLORE[/b][/h2]
With new Expeditions to explore Tokyo and Las Vegas, operatives will have plenty to do in Episode 4. New features in these areas will include the ability to move freely throughout the map, and include the use of new modes of transportation–Ridroids! Additional Ridroid Quests can also be accepted via the Quest Counter, if you find yourself becoming fond of them. Of course, these new areas mean there are new items to find in them, and a few of them include:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/c2f08f7beddd65e915da1aadcc92ea510fbaf3ca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/2a2939d555ed9294e5e83f1f424cff1e1b1eb130.png[/img][/url]
S. CN Mantis | Soaring Blades, ★13

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/474eb6a85d0a590d1c93582a6dc7a06b59e659c5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/b346f5426f92c0a0c040c68ccee5893d50565807.png[/img][/url]
Quotz Vidiya | Knuckles, ★13

PvP has made its way to the Ships! Well, the [u]UNIVERSAL SHIP[/u], that is. This Ship will host operatives from the whole fleet who are desirous of testing their might against their fellow Arks in the [u]BATTLE ARENA[/u], as well as those looking for allies to undertake [u]CHALLENGE QUESTS[/u]. In the Battle Arena, defeating opponents and claiming victory in your matches will earn you [b]Battle Coin[/b], which can be redeemed at the Battle Coin Exchange Shop. There is also a [u]LIMITED EXCHANGE[/u] menu where SG can be purchased with Battle Coins every week! You can purchase 10SG up to 5 times and 5SG up to 10 times for a total of 100SG! [h2][b]NEW STORY
[/b][/h2]Odd Arks seems to have infiltrated Fleet Oracle, but is their purpose nefarious? Discover their origin while you explore the newly-discovered planet, Earth, and learn of the parallels between your home and Earth. New characters and old friends will join you on your quest to curtail the Falspawn and other hostile entities. You’ll battle new enemies–Phantasms–the manifested fear and dread of Earth’s citizens, comprised of “Aether” particles and able to move as dust on the wind.


There’s more included, but we don’t want to spoil all the fun for you! Just make sure join us in Phantasy Star Online 2 on[b] August 5th[/b], when we welcome operatives from an additional 33 countries! See you on Earth, operatives!


 - The PSO2 Team
